Intelligence officers must encipher a message before transmission. 情报官员必须在传输前加密信息。 | en->使成为，cipher->密码，encipher->使成为密码=加密（cf. decipher破译，encrypt加密） || 文化联想：中文“把情报加密后再发送”最适合帮助记忆 encipher，可以说 **encipher a message — “An intelligence officer may encipher a message before transmitting it over an insecure channel.”**

quiz.question: ___ gusher
quiz.explanation: 喷涌的东西, 油井喷涌. The prospectors struck an oil gusher in the Texas plains. 勘探者在德克萨斯平原上发现了一个喷油井。 | gush->喷涌（古挪威gjósa），gusher->喷涌的东西=喷油井/过分热情的人（cf. gust一阵风，gust of enthusiasm热情迸发） || 文化联想：gusher 常用于喷涌的油井，可用中国石油勘探史里的喷油场景来记忆，可以说 **an oil gusher — “During early oil exploration, striking a highly pressurized reservoir could produce an oil gusher that sprayed crude high into the air.”**

quiz.question: ______ bather
quiz.explanation: 沐浴者, 公共泳者. The public bather enjoyed swimming at the community pool. 公共泳者喜欢在社区游泳池游泳。 | bath->沐浴（古英语bæth），bather->沐浴者（cf. bath浴室，bathe沐浴，bathroom浴室） || 文化联想：中国公共泳池里的游泳者最适合帮助记忆 bather，可以说 **a public bather — “A public bather at a community pool should shower first and follow the posted hygiene rules.”**

quiz.question: bellwether _____
quiz.explanation: 领头羊; 指标, 指标股. Analysts watch the bellwether stock to predict market trends. 分析师关注指标股以预测市场趋势。 | bell->铃铛，wether->阉割的公羊，bellwether->脖子上挂铃铛领路的公羊=先驱/指标（cf. whether是否，weather天气） || 文化联想：中文“风向标、领头羊”最适合帮助记忆 bellwether，可以说 **a market bellwether — “A large technology company can become a market bellwether whose results influence expectations for the broader sector.”**

quiz.question: _____ panther
quiz.explanation: 黑豹, 黑豹. The black panther moved silently through the jungle. 黑豹无声地穿过丛林。 | panthera->豹（希腊），panther->豹（黑豹是豹的黑色变体，cf. leopard豹，pantheon万神殿） || 文化联想：中国动物园里黑色豹类的形象最适合帮助记忆 panther，可以说 **a black panther — “At a zoo, visitors may see a black panther whose dark coat makes the animal look almost shadow-like.”**

quiz.question: cavalier ________
quiz.explanation: 骑士; 傲慢的, 傲慢的态度. His cavalier attitude toward safety rules worried his colleagues. 他对安全规则的傲慢态度让同事们担心。 | caval->马（拉丁caballus），cavalier->骑马的人=骑士（骑马者态度傲慢）=轻慢的（cf. cavalry骑兵，chivalry骑士精神） || 文化联想：中文“满不在乎、不把规则当回事”最适合帮助记忆 cavalier，可以说 **a cavalier attitude — “A driver who ignores basic safety rules may show a cavalier attitude toward other people’s lives.”**

quiz.question: _______ chandelier
quiz.explanation: 枝形吊灯, 水晶吊灯. The crystal chandelier sparkled in the ballroom. 水晶吊灯在舞厅里闪闪发光。 | chandelle->蜡烛（法语），chandelier->悬挂多支蜡烛的灯架=枝形吊灯（cf. candle蜡烛，chandler蜡烛商） || 文化联想：老上海饭店或豪宅大厅里的水晶吊灯最适合帮助记忆 chandelier，可以说 **a crystal chandelier — “A restored ballroom in old Shanghai may have a crystal chandelier hanging above the center of the room.”**

quiz.question: _______ pier
quiz.explanation: 码头; 桥墩, 钓鱼码头. Locals gathered at the fishing pier every morning. 当地人每天早上都聚集在钓鱼码头。 | pier->支柱/码头（古法语piere->石头），pier->伸入水中的石头平台=码头（cf. pier glass立式穿衣镜） || 文化联想：青岛、大连等沿海城市的钓鱼码头最适合帮助记忆 pier，可以说 **a fishing pier — “Local residents may gather on a fishing pier early in the morning to cast lines into the sea.”**

quiz.question: ____________ dossier
quiz.explanation: 档案; 卷宗, 情报档案. The spy carried a classified intelligence dossier. 间谍携带了一份机密情报档案。 | dos->背部（法语），dossier->背部有标签的文件捆=档案卷宗（cf. dose剂量，dorsal背部的） || 文化联想：中文“卷宗档案”最适合帮助记忆 dossier，可以说 **an intelligence dossier — “An investigator may compile an intelligence dossier containing reports, photographs, and background information on a suspect.”**

quiz.question: pucker ____
quiz.explanation: 皱起; 撅起, 撅起嘴唇. She would pucker lips when tasting something sour. 她尝到酸的东西时会撅起嘴唇。 | pucker->皱褶（可能来自pocket口袋），pucker->收缩成皱褶=撅起（cf. pocket口袋，puckered皱的） || 文化联想：吃到山西老陈醋或青梅时下意识撅嘴最适合帮助记忆 pucker，可以说 **pucker one’s lips — “A child tasting a very sour preserved plum may pucker the lips immediately.”**

quiz.question: canker ____
quiz.explanation: 溃疡; 腐蚀, 口腔溃疡. The painful canker sore made eating difficult. 疼痛的口腔溃疡使进食困难。 | cancer->螃蟹（拉丁，因溃疡形似螃蟹爪），canker->腐蚀性溃疡（cf. cancer癌症，chancre下疳，同词源） || 文化联想：中文“口腔溃疡”最适合帮助记忆 canker，可以说 **a canker sore — “A painful canker sore inside the mouth can make eating spicy food uncomfortable.”**

quiz.question: ____-______ broker
quiz.explanation: 经纪人, 房地产经纪人. The real-estate broker showed us several properties. 房地产经纪人向我们展示了几处房产。 | brocher->打开酒桶（古法语），broker->最初指开桶卖酒的人=中间商/经纪人（cf. broke破产，brokerage经纪业） || 文化联想：中国买房时常接触房地产经纪人，最适合帮助记忆 broker，可以说 **a real-estate broker — “A buyer may ask a real-estate broker to arrange showings and explain local listings.”**

quiz.question: ______ hawker
quiz.explanation: 小贩, 街头小贩. The street hawker sold fresh fruit from his cart. 街头小贩从他的推车上卖新鲜水果。 | hawk->鹰/兜售，hawker->像鹰一样四处搜寻顾客的人=小贩（cf. hawk叫卖，huckster小贩） || 文化联想：老式街市里推车叫卖水果的小贩最适合帮助记忆 hawker，可以说 **a street hawker — “A street hawker may call out loudly while selling fruit or snacks from a small cart.”**

quiz.question: ______ dabbler
quiz.explanation: 业余爱好者; 涉猎者, 业余涉猎者. He was just a casual dabbler in photography, not a professional. 他只是摄影的业余涉猎者,不是专业人士。 | dabble->轻拍水面/浅尝（dab->轻触），dabbler->浅尝辄止的人=业余涉猎者（cf. dip浅试） || 文化联想：中文“浅尝辄止”最适合帮助记忆 dabbler，可以说 **a casual dabbler — “Someone who tries calligraphy for a few weekends without serious study is only a casual dabbler.”**

quiz.question: _______ cobbler
quiz.explanation: 鞋匠; 水果馅饼, 村里的鞋匠. The village cobbler repaired shoes for the community. 村里的鞋匠为社区修鞋。 | cobbler->鞋匠（来源不明，可能来自cobble->鹅卵石，修路人），cobbler->鞋匠/水果派（两义） || 文化联想：老街里给居民修鞋的鞋匠最适合帮助记忆 cobbler，可以说 **a village cobbler — “A village cobbler may repair worn soles and replace broken heels for local residents.”**

quiz.question: ____ wrangler
quiz.explanation: 牧马人; 争论者, 首席牧马人. The head wrangler supervised all the ranch hands. 首席牧马人监督所有牧场工人。 | wrangler->争辩者（低地德语wrangeln->扭打），wrangler->牛仔/争论者（cf. wrangle争吵，wrangle cattle管理牛群） || 文化联想：wrangler 在这里指牧场管理牲畜的人，可用中国观众熟悉的西部片语境来记忆，可以说 **a head wrangler — “In a Western film watched by Chinese audiences, the head wrangler may supervise horses and ranch hands.”**

quiz.question: potboiler _____
quiz.explanation: 粗制滥造的作品, 粗制滥造的小说. The author wrote a potboiler novel to pay the bills. 作者写了一部粗制滥造的小说来支付账单。 | pot->锅，boiler->烧锅，potboiler->为了让锅不空（糊口）而匆忙写成的=粗制滥造的作品 || 文化联想：中文“为了糊口赶写出来的俗套作品”最适合帮助记忆 potboiler，可以说 **a potboiler novel — “An author who quickly writes a formulaic thriller simply to pay the bills may produce a potboiler novel.”**

quiz.question: tickler ____
quiz.explanation: 提醒物; 备忘录, 提醒文件. Keep a tickler file to remember important deadlines. 保留一个提醒文件来记住重要的截止日期。 | tickle->触动/挠痒，tickler->触动记忆的东西=提醒备忘（cf. ticklish敏感的，tickler file提醒系统） || 文化联想：公司里按日期整理待办事项的提醒档案最适合帮助记忆 tickler，可以说 **a tickler file — “An office worker may keep a tickler file that brings important deadlines back to attention on the right day.”**

quiz.question: _ stickler ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 坚持细节的人; 固执者, 对细节很坚持的人. She is a stickler for detail in all her work. 她在所有工作中都是一个对细节很坚持的人。 | stickle->坚持（古英语stihtan->安排），stickler->坚持规则的人（cf. stick坚持，stickler for rules规则控） || 文化联想：中文“一丝不苟、对细节特别较真”最适合帮助记忆 stickler，可以说 **a stickler for detail — “A careful editor who checks every punctuation mark may be a stickler for detail—真正做到‘一丝不苟.’”**

quiz.question: ________ propeller
quiz.explanation: 螺旋桨, 飞机螺旋桨. The airplane propeller spun rapidly before takeoff. 飞机螺旋桨在起飞前快速旋转。 | pro->向前，pell->推，propeller->向前推进的装置=螺旋桨（cf. propel推进，compel强迫，repel排斥） || 文化联想：中国航空博物馆里的螺旋桨飞机最适合帮助记忆 propeller，可以说 **an airplane propeller — “An old propeller aircraft in an aviation museum has an airplane propeller mounted at the front of the engine.”**

quiz.question: ____ painkiller
quiz.explanation: 止痛药, 服用止痛药. The doctor advised me to take painkiller for the headache. 医生建议我服用止痛药来治疗头痛。 | pain->痛，killer->杀手，painkiller->杀死疼痛的药=止痛药（cf. thriller惊悚片，thriller=thrill+er） || 文化联想：中文“头疼吃止痛药”最适合帮助记忆 painkiller，可以说 **take a painkiller — “Someone with a bad headache may take a painkiller according to the medicine label or a doctor’s advice.”**

quiz.question: ______ sampler
quiz.explanation: 样品; 刺绣样品, 刺绣样品. The antique needle sampler displayed beautiful stitching. 古董刺绣样品展示了美丽的针法。 | sample->样本（拉丁exemplum），sampler->展示样本的刺绣/采样器（cf. example例子，example->exemplum） || 文化联想：苏绣或十字绣展示针法的样品最适合帮助记忆 sampler，可以说 **a needlework sampler — “An embroidery student may stitch a needlework sampler to practice several traditional patterns and techniques.”**

quiz.question: ______ rustler
quiz.explanation: 偷牛贼, 偷牛贼. The sheriff arrested the cattle rustler on the open range. 警长在开阔牧场上逮捕了偷牛贼。 | rustle->沙沙作响/偷盗（象声词，偷偷拿走时的声音），rustler->偷牛者（cf. hustle拼命，bustle忙碌） || 文化联想：rustler 是美国西部“偷牛贼”概念，可用中国观众熟悉的西部片来记忆，可以说 **a cattle rustler — “In a Western movie, a cattle rustler may secretly drive stolen cattle away from another ranch.”**

quiz.question: howler _______
quiz.explanation: 咆哮者; 大错误, 严重错误. The typo in the headline was a howler mistake. 标题中的拼写错误是一个严重错误。 | howl->嚎叫，howler->引人嚎叫的大错误（cf. howler monkey嚎猴，howl嚎叫） || 文化联想：中文“低级到让人哭笑不得的大错误”最适合帮助记忆 howler，可以说 **a howler of a mistake — “Printing the wrong city name in a newspaper headline would be a howler of a mistake.”**

quiz.question: ______ sizzler
quiz.explanation: 炎热的天气; 热门事物, 炎热的夏天. This summer sizzler brought record-breaking temperatures. 这个炎热的夏天带来了创纪录的高温。 | sizzle->发出嘶嘶声（象声词，热锅上的声音），sizzler->令人如处热锅的=炎热天气/热门事物 || 文化联想：中国南方极端高温天像“蒸笼”一样，最适合帮助记忆 sizzler，可以说 **a summer sizzler — “A week of temperatures near forty degrees can turn July into a real summer sizzler.”**

quiz.question: ________ disclaimer
quiz.explanation: 免责声明, 保修免责声明. Read the warranty disclaimer carefully before purchasing. 购买前仔细阅读保修免责声明。 | dis->否定，claim->声称，disclaimer->否认声称=免责声明（cf. claim声称，disclaim否认，reclaim收回） || 文化联想：中国网购时常见保修和责任限制说明，最适合帮助记忆 disclaimer，可以说 **a warranty disclaimer — “Before buying an electronic product, a customer should read the warranty disclaimer describing what is not covered.”**

quiz.question: ______ hammer
quiz.explanation: 锤子, 大锤. The worker swung the sledge hammer to break the concrete. 工人挥动大锤打碎混凝土。 | hammer->锤（古英语hamor），sledge->雪橇/大锤（古英语slecg->沉重的锤），sledgehammer->像雪橇一样沉重的锤 || 文化联想：工地拿大锤砸混凝土最适合帮助记忆 hammer，可以说 **a sledge hammer — “A demolition worker may swing a heavy sledge hammer to break old concrete.”**

quiz.question: ___ _ sledgehammer
quiz.explanation: 大锤, 使用大锤. You'll need to use a sledgehammer to demolish that wall. 你需要使用大锤来拆除那堵墙。 | sledgehammer->用大锤（a sledgehammer approach->用大锤处理=粗暴/过激的方式） || 文化联想：中文“大锤式处理法”最适合帮助记忆 sledgehammer，可以说 **a sledgehammer approach — “Using the harshest possible rule to solve a small problem may be a sledgehammer approach.”**

quiz.question: ______ misnomer
quiz.explanation: 用词不当; 误称, 常见的误称. Calling it a jellyfish is a common misnomer since they're not fish. 称其为水母是一个常见的误称,因为它们不是鱼。 | mis->错误，nomer->名字（拉丁nomen），misnomer->错误的名字=误称（cf. nominate提名，nominal名义的） || 文化联想：中文“名不副实、叫错名字”最适合帮助记忆 misnomer，可以说 **a common misnomer — “Calling every Chinese steamed bun a ‘dumpling’ can sometimes be a common misnomer because the categories are not identical.”**

quiz.question: ______ informer
quiz.explanation: 告密者; 线人, 警方线人. The police informer provided crucial information about the gang. 警方线人提供了关于该团伙的关键信息。 | in->进入，form->形式/告知，informer->向警方告知的人=线人（cf. inform通知，information信息） || 文化联想：刑侦剧里给警方提供线索的线人最适合帮助记忆 informer，可以说 **a police informer — “A police informer may secretly provide investigators with information about an organized-crime group.”**

quiz.question: _______ designer
quiz.explanation: 设计师, 时装设计师. The famous fashion designer unveiled her new collection. 著名时装设计师发布了她的新系列。 | de->彻底，sign->标记，designer->精心标记设计的人=设计师（cf. sign标志，assign指定，designate指定） || 文化联想：上海时装周上的服装设计师最适合帮助记忆 designer，可以说 **a fashion designer — “A fashion designer may present a new collection at Shanghai Fashion Week.”**

quiz.question: _____ retainer
quiz.explanation: 聘用金; 固定器, 法律聘用金. The client paid a legal retainer to secure the lawyer's services. 客户支付了法律聘用金以获得律师的服务。 | re->继续，tain->持有，retainer->使持续持有的东西=聘用金/固定器（cf. retain保留，detain拘留） || 文化联想：请律师前先支付一笔聘用金的场景最适合帮助记忆 retainer，可以说 **a legal retainer — “A client may pay a legal retainer before a lawyer begins ongoing work on a complicated case.”**

quiz.question: ________ mariner
quiz.explanation: 水手; 海员, 经验丰富的水手. The seasoned mariner navigated through the storm with skill. 经验丰富的水手熟练地在暴风雨中航行。 | mare->海（拉丁），mariner->海上的人=水手（cf. marine海洋的，maritime海事的，submarine潜水艇） || 文化联想：郑和下西洋最适合帮助记忆 mariner，可以说 **a seasoned mariner — “A seasoned mariner on Zheng He’s voyages would need experience with winds, currents, navigation, and long periods at sea.”**

quiz.question: forerunner __________
quiz.explanation: 先驱; 前身, 先驱技术. The telegraph was a forerunner technology to modern communications. 电报是现代通信的先驱技术。 | fore->前，runner->跑者，forerunner->前方的跑者=先驱（cf. precursor先驱，predecessor前任） || 文化联想：中国早期电报可作为现代通信技术的前身来记忆 forerunner，可以说 **a technological forerunner — “The telegraph was a technological forerunner of later long-distance electronic communication.”**

quiz.question: _______ practitioner
quiz.explanation: 从业者; 执业者, 医疗从业者. The medical practitioner diagnosed the patient's condition. 医疗从业者诊断了患者的病情。 | practice->实践，itioner->执行者后缀，practitioner->将知识付诸实践的人=从业者（cf. practice实践，practical实际的） || 文化联想：中国医院里执业医生最适合帮助记忆 practitioner，可以说 **a medical practitioner — “A licensed medical practitioner may diagnose illness, prescribe treatment, and advise patients.”**

quiz.question: _____ petitioner
quiz.explanation: 请愿者; 上诉人, 法院上诉人. The court petitioner filed documents requesting a hearing. 法院上诉人提交了要求听证的文件。 | petit->请求（拉丁petere），petitioner->提出请求的人=请愿者（cf. petition请愿，compete竞争=一起请求） || 文化联想：中文“请愿人/申请人”最适合帮助记忆 petitioner，可以说 **a court petitioner — “A court petitioner may file documents asking a judge to grant a specific legal remedy.”**

quiz.question: garner _______
quiz.explanation: 获得; 收集, 获得支持. The candidate worked hard to garner support from voters. 候选人努力工作以获得选民的支持。 | granarium->粮仓（拉丁），garner->像粮仓一样积累=收集（cf. granary粮仓，grain谷粒，garner support收集支持） || 文化联想：中文“聚沙成塔地争取支持”最适合帮助记忆 garner，可以说 **garner support — “A community project may garner support gradually as more residents understand its benefits.”**

quiz.question: ______ vintner
quiz.explanation: 酿酒商, 法国酿酒商. The French vintner produced exceptional wines from his vineyard. 法国酿酒商从他的葡萄园生产出了卓越的葡萄酒。 | vinum->葡萄酒（拉丁），vintner->葡萄酒商人（cf. wine葡萄酒，vine葡萄藤，vintage年份酒） || 文化联想：宁夏葡萄酒产区的酿酒师最适合帮助记忆 vintner，可以说 **a Chinese vintner — “A vintner in Ningxia may select grapes, supervise fermentation, and decide how long a wine should age.”**

quiz.question: caper _____
quiz.explanation: 雀跃; 恶作剧, 雀跃. The children would caper about in the playground joyfully. 孩子们会在操场上欢快地雀跃。 | caper->跳跃（拉丁capriolus->小山羊），caper->像小山羊一样蹦跳=雀跃/恶作剧（cf. capriole马的跃起，capricorn山羊座） || 文化联想：孩子过春节拿到红包后开心得蹦蹦跳跳，最适合帮助记忆 caper，可以说 **caper about — “Excited children may caper about the living room after receiving red envelopes at Spring Festival.”**

quiz.question: _____ reaper
quiz.explanation: 收割者; 收割机, 谷物收割机. The farmer used a grain reaper to harvest the wheat. 农民使用谷物收割机收割小麦。 | reap->收割（古英语reopan），reaper->收割者（the Grim Reaper->死神=收割灵魂的人） || 文化联想：东北麦田里的收割机最适合帮助记忆 reaper，可以说 **a grain reaper — “At harvest time, a grain reaper can cut large areas of wheat much faster than hand tools.”**

quiz.question: _____ damper
quiz.explanation: 减震器; 制音器, 钢琴制音器. The piano damper stops the strings from vibrating. 钢琴制音器阻止琴弦振动。 | damp->抑制/潮湿，damper->抑制振动的装置=制音器（put a damper on->给...泼冷水） || 文化联想：钢琴踏板和制音系统最适合帮助记忆 damper，可以说 **a piano damper — “When a pianist releases a key, a piano damper can stop the string from continuing to vibrate.”**

quiz.question: _______ hamper
quiz.explanation: 妨碍; 洗衣篮, 洗衣篮. Put your dirty clothes in the laundry hamper. 把你的脏衣服放进洗衣篮。 | hamper->大篮子/妨碍（古法语hanapier->杯架），hamper->装东西的大篮/妨碍（两义） || 文化联想：中国家庭常见装脏衣服的大篮子最适合帮助记忆 hamper，可以说 **a laundry hamper — “Family members may put dirty clothes into a laundry hamper before wash day.”**

quiz.question: temper _______
quiz.explanation: 脾气; 调和, 调和正义. The judge must temper justice with mercy. 法官必须以仁慈调和正义。 | tempus->时间/混合（拉丁），temper->适度调和（cf. temperature温度，temperament性情，temperate温和的） || 文化联想：包公故事中“执法有度、宽严相济”最适合帮助记忆 temper，可以说 **temper justice with mercy — “A fair judge may temper justice with mercy when circumstances justify compassion.”**

quiz.question: _________ interloper
quiz.explanation: 闯入者; 干涉者, 不受欢迎的闯入者. The unwelcome interloper disrupted the private meeting. 不受欢迎的闯入者扰乱了私人会议。 | inter->之间，loper->闯入者（荷兰loopen->跑），interloper->闯入中间的人=干涉者（cf. elope私奔=跑走） || 文化联想：中文“不速之客”最适合帮助记忆 interloper，可以说 **an unwelcome interloper — “A stranger who barges into a private family meeting may be treated as an unwelcome interloper.”**

quiz.question: dapper _______
quiz.explanation: 衣着整洁的; 精神的, 穿着整洁的人. He was known as a dapper dresser with impeccable style. 他以穿着整洁、风格无可挑剔而闻名。 | dapper->整洁（荷兰语dapper->勇敢/敏捷），dapper->衣着整洁精神的（cf. natty整洁，spruce精神的） || 文化联想：民国上海老照片里西装笔挺的绅士最适合帮助记忆 dapper，可以说 **a dapper gentleman — “A man in a neatly tailored suit and polished shoes may look like a dapper gentleman from old Shanghai.”**

quiz.question: clipper ____
quiz.explanation: 快速帆船; 剪刀, 快速帆船. The clipper ship sailed swiftly across the ocean. 快速帆船迅速驶过大洋。 | clip->剪/快速移动，clipper->剪得很快的/快速帆船（cf. clip剪，clippers剪刀，clipping剪报） || 文化联想：clipper 是十九世纪快速帆船，可用中国海事博物馆里的模型来记忆，可以说 **a clipper ship — “A maritime museum may display a model of a clipper ship built for speed on long ocean routes.”**

quiz.question: _ pauper's _____
quiz.explanation: 贫民; 穷人, 贫民的坟墓. He was buried in a pauper's grave with no marker. 他被埋葬在一个没有标记的贫民的坟墓里。 | pauper->穷人（拉丁pauper->贫乏），pauper->一无所有的人（cf. poor穷，poverty贫困，impoverish使贫穷） || 文化联想：中文“家徒四壁、一贫如洗”最适合帮助记忆 pauper，可以说 **a penniless pauper — “A character who owns almost nothing and depends entirely on charity may be described as a penniless pauper—近似‘家徒四壁.’”**

quiz.question: _____ treasurer
quiz.explanation: 财务主管; 司库, 州财务主管. The state treasurer manages public funds. 州财务主管管理公共资金。 | thesaurus->宝库（希腊），treasurer->管理宝库的人=财务主管（cf. treasury财政部，thesaurus同义词典） || 文化联想：地方财政部门里的财务主管最适合帮助记忆 treasurer，可以说 **a city treasurer — “A city treasurer may oversee public funds, payments, and financial records.”**

quiz.question: miser's _____
quiz.explanation: 守财奴, 守财奴的储藏. The miser's hoard of gold was discovered after his death. 守财奴的储藏黄金在他死后被发现。 | miser->悲惨（拉丁miser->悲惨的），miser->因过度吝啬而悲惨的人=守财奴（cf. miserable悲惨的，misery痛苦） || 文化联想：中文“守财奴把钱藏起来”最适合帮助记忆 miser，可以说 **a miser’s hoard — “A miser may hide a hoard of coins for decades rather than spend money even on basic comfort.”**

quiz.question: _____ hawser
quiz.explanation: 粗缆绳, 钢缆绳. The ship was secured to the dock with a steel hawser. 船用钢缆绳固定在码头上。 | hausser->升起（古法语，来自拉丁altus->高），hawser->用来升锚的粗缆=粗缆绳（cf. hoist升起，haul拖拉） || 文化联想：上海港大型船舶用粗缆绳系泊最适合帮助记忆 hawser，可以说 **a steel hawser — “A large vessel may be secured to the dock with a heavy steel hawser.”**

quiz.question: geyser ________
quiz.explanation: 间歇泉, 间歇泉喷发. Tourists gathered to watch the geyser eruption at Yellowstone. 游客聚集在黄石公园观看间歇泉喷发。 | Geysir->冰岛著名间歇泉（来自古挪威geysa->喷涌），geyser->间歇泉（cf. gush喷涌） || 文化联想：云南腾冲火山地热景区可帮助记忆 geyser，可以说 **a geyser eruption — “At a geothermal site, visitors may watch hot water suddenly shoot upward during a geyser eruption.”**

quiz.question: cater _____
quiz.explanation: 承办酒席; 迎合, 承办活动. The restaurant will cater event for the wedding reception. 餐厅将为婚宴承办活动。 | acater->采购食物者（古法语），cater->采购食物/提供餐饮（cf. caterer餐饮承包商，catering餐饮服务） || 文化联想：中国婚宴由酒店承办餐饮最适合帮助记忆 cater，可以说 **cater an event — “A hotel may cater an event by preparing food, drinks, tables, and service for a wedding banquet.”**

quiz.question: idolater _______
quiz.explanation: 偶像崇拜者, 偶像崇拜. The idolater worship of celebrities can be excessive. 对名人的偶像崇拜可能过度。 | idol->偶像，later->崇拜者（希腊latreia->崇拜），idolater->崇拜偶像的人（cf. idol偶像，idolatry偶像崇拜） || 文化联想：中文“把明星当神一样崇拜”最适合帮助记忆 idolater，可以说 **a celebrity idolater — “A fan who treats a celebrity as incapable of any fault may behave like a celebrity idolater.”**

quiz.question: ________ crater
quiz.explanation: 火山口; 坑, 火山口. The volcanic crater was still steaming from recent activity. 火山口仍在冒着最近活动的蒸汽。 | krater->混合碗（希腊，古代混合葡萄酒的大碗），crater->碗状的坑=火山口（cf. krater古希腊混酒碗） || 文化联想：长白山天池所在的火山口最适合帮助记忆 crater，可以说 **a volcanic crater — “Tianchi occupies a volcanic crater formed by past eruptions of Changbai Mountain.”**

quiz.question: _____ backwater
quiz.explanation: 死水; 落后地区, 农村落后地区. The town was dismissed as a rural backwater by city dwellers. 这个城镇被城市居民认为是农村落后地区。 | back->倒退，water->水，backwater->向后流的死水=落后地区（cf. backlog积压，setback挫折） || 文化联想：中文“偏远落后的小地方”最适合帮助记忆 backwater，可以说 **a rural backwater — “A remote town with little transport and few jobs may be unfairly dismissed as a rural backwater.”**

quiz.question: _______ specter
quiz.explanation: 幽灵; 恐怖的景象, 幽灵般的鬼魂. A ghostly specter appeared in the haunted mansion. 幽灵般的鬼魂出现在闹鬼的豪宅中。 | spect->看（拉丁spectare），specter->能看到的东西=幽灵（cf. spectre幽灵，spectrum光谱，spectacle奇观） || 文化联想：《聊斋志异》里的幽灵形象最适合帮助记忆 specter，可以说 **a ghostly specter — “In a Strange Tales story, a ghostly specter may appear beside an abandoned temple at night.”**

quiz.question: deter _____
quiz.explanation: 阻止; 威慑, 威慑犯罪. Strict laws help deter crime in the community. 严格的法律有助于威慑社区的犯罪。 | de->离开，ter->使恐惧（拉丁terrere），deter->使通过恐惧而离开=威慑（cf. terror恐惧，terrible可怕的） || 文化联想：中文“杀鸡儆猴”的威慑逻辑最适合帮助记忆 deter，可以说 **deter wrongdoing — “A visible penalty may help deter wrongdoing by showing others that violations have consequences.”**

quiz.question: ______ diameter
quiz.explanation: 直径, 圆的直径. Measure the circle diameter from edge to edge. 从边缘到边缘测量圆的直径。 | dia->穿过，meter->测量，diameter->穿过圆心测量=直径（cf. diagonal对角线，perimeter周长） || 文化联想：中国中学几何课量圆的直径最适合帮助记忆 diameter，可以说 **the diameter of a circle — “A student measures the diameter of a circle by drawing a line through the center from one edge to the other.”**

quiz.question: _______ parameter
quiz.explanation: 参数, 可调参数. The model includes a tunable parameter for optimization. 该模型包括一个用于优化的可调参数。 | para->旁边，meter->测量，parameter->旁边的测量值=参数（cf. perimeter周长，barometer气压计） || 文化联想：程序员调模型参数最适合帮助记忆 parameter，可以说 **a tunable parameter — “An engineer may adjust a tunable parameter to improve a model’s performance on validation data.”**

quiz.question: perimeter _____
quiz.explanation: 周长; 周边, 周边围栏. Security guards patrol the perimeter fence regularly. 保安定期巡逻周边围栏。 | peri->周围，meter->测量，perimeter->测量周围=周长/周边（cf. diameter直径，parameter参数） || 文化联想：故宫外围宫墙形成清晰周界，最适合帮助记忆 perimeter，可以说 **the outer perimeter — “Security staff may patrol the outer perimeter of a large historic complex after closing time.”**

quiz.question: odometer _______
quiz.explanation: 里程表, 里程表读数. The odometer reading showed the car had traveled 50,000 miles. 里程表读数显示汽车已行驶5万英里。 | odo->路（希腊hodos），meter->测量，odometer->测量行路距离=里程表（cf. method方法=沿路走，episode插曲） || 文化联想：中国二手车交易里查里程表读数最适合帮助记忆 odometer，可以说 **an odometer reading — “A used-car buyer may compare the odometer reading with maintenance records before deciding on a price.”**

quiz.question: ____ slaughter
quiz.explanation: 屠杀; 大量杀戮, 大屠杀. The battle resulted in a mass slaughter of soldiers. 这场战斗导致了士兵的大屠杀。 | slaughter->屠杀（古挪威slátr->屠宰），slaughterhouse->屠宰场（cf. daughter女儿，同音不同义） || 文化联想：抗战史中惨烈战役造成大量伤亡的场景最适合帮助记忆 slaughter，可以说 **mass slaughter — “A battle in which large numbers of defenseless people are deliberately killed can become an act of mass slaughter.”**

quiz.question: _____ arbiter
quiz.explanation: 仲裁者; 裁决者, 最终仲裁者. The Supreme Court serves as the final arbiter of the law. 最高法院是法律的最终仲裁者。 | arbiter->目击者/仲裁者（拉丁），arbiter->仲裁判决者（cf. arbitrate仲裁，arbitrary武断的=仲裁者说了算） || 文化联想：中文“最终裁决者”最适合帮助记忆 arbiter，可以说 **the final arbiter — “In a formal dispute, an agreed arbitration panel may serve as the final arbiter of the contract issue.”**

quiz.question: loiter ______
quiz.explanation: 闲荡; 徘徊, 四处闲荡. Don't loiter around the store entrance. 不要在商店门口四处闲荡。 | loiter->徘徊（荷兰语loteren->摇晃），loiter->无目的地徘徊（cf. idle闲逛，linger逗留） || 文化联想：中文“在门口闲晃”最适合帮助记忆 loiter，可以说 **loiter around — “Security staff may ask people not to loiter around a building entrance and block other visitors.”**

quiz.question: reconnoiter ____
quiz.explanation: 侦察, 侦察区域. The scouts were sent ahead to reconnoiter area before the attack. 侦察兵被派去在进攻前侦察区域。 | re->再次，connoiter->认识/了解（拉丁cognoscere），reconnoiter->重新了解地形=侦察（cf. recognize认识，cognition认知） || 文化联想：古代斥候先去查看山口和敌情最适合帮助记忆 reconnoiter，可以说 **reconnoiter the area — “Before an army enters an unfamiliar valley, scouts may reconnoiter the area and report roads, terrain, and threats.”**

quiz.question: alter _ _____
quiz.explanation: 改变; 修改, 修改一件衣服. The tailor will alter a dress to fit you perfectly. 裁缝将修改一件衣服以完美适合你。 | alter->另一个（拉丁alter），alter->使成为另一个样子=改变（cf. alternate交替，alternative另一选择，altercation争吵） || 文化联想：旗袍或礼服不合身时请裁缝修改最适合帮助记忆 alter，可以说 **alter a dress — “A tailor may alter a dress by taking in the waist or shortening the hem.”**

quiz.question: palter ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 含糊其辞; 欺骗, 对真相含糊其辞. Politicians often palter with truth during election campaigns. 政客们在竞选活动中经常对真相含糊其辞。 | palter->模糊敷衍（可能来自paltry->不值钱），palter->含糊其辞欺骗（cf. paltry微不足道的，falter踌躇） || 文化联想：中文“含糊其辞、说半真半假的话”最适合帮助记忆 palter，可以说 **palter with the truth — “Someone who gives technically true but deliberately misleading answers may palter with the truth—也就是‘含糊其辞.’”**

quiz.question: _ welter __ ____
quiz.explanation: 混乱; 杂乱, 大量数据的混乱. The researcher faced a welter of data to analyze. 研究人员面临大量数据的混乱需要分析。 | welter->翻滚（中古荷兰语welteren），welter->翻滚的混乱/大量（cf. swelter酷热，welterweight次中量级） || 文化联想：中文“一团乱麻的数据”最适合帮助记忆 welter，可以说 **a welter of data — “An analyst opening dozens of inconsistent spreadsheets may face a welter of data before any clear pattern emerges.”**

quiz.question: _______ banter
quiz.explanation: 玩笑; 戏谑, 有趣的玩笑. The friends exchanged playful banter over dinner. 朋友们在晚餐时交换有趣的玩笑。 | banter->戏谑（来源不明，17世纪出现），banter->轻松戏谑的交谈（cf. banter vs irony vs sarcasm程度递增） || 文化联想：朋友聚餐时互相开玩笑最适合帮助记忆 banter，可以说 **playful banter — “Old classmates at a reunion may exchange playful banter about stories from their school days.”**

quiz.question: _______ carpenter
quiz.explanation: 木匠, 熟练的木匠. The skilled carpenter crafted beautiful furniture. 熟练的木匠制作了精美的家具。 | carpentarius->制作双轮马车的人（拉丁carpentum->马车），carpenter->木工（cf. car汽车，carriage马车，同词源） || 文化联想：故宫古建修缮里的木匠最适合帮助记忆 carpenter，可以说 **a skilled carpenter — “A skilled carpenter restoring an old wooden building may reproduce traditional joints without visible nails.”**

quiz.question: __ presenter
quiz.explanation: 主持人, 电视主持人. The TV presenter interviewed the celebrity guest. 电视主持人采访了名人嘉宾。 | present->呈现/在场，presenter->将内容呈现给观众的人=主持人（cf. present礼物/呈现，representation代表） || 文化联想：中文电视新闻主持人最适合帮助记忆 presenter，可以说 **a TV presenter — “A TV presenter may introduce the evening headlines before interviewing guests in the studio.”**

quiz.question: inter ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 埋葬, 埋葬尸体. They decided to inter the body in the family cemetery. 他们决定在家族墓地埋葬尸体。 | inter->进入土地（拉丁in+terra->土地），inter->埋入土中=埋葬（cf. terrain地形，territory领土，Mediterranean地中海） || 文化联想：清明安葬先人最适合帮助记忆 inter，可以说 **inter the body — “After a funeral ceremony, a family may inter the body in a cemetery according to local custom.”**

quiz.question: disinter _______
quiz.explanation: 挖出; 发掘, 挖出遗骸. Archaeologists worked to disinter remains from the ancient site. 考古学家努力从古代遗址挖出遗骸。 | dis->去除，inter->埋葬，disinter->从土地中取出=挖出/发掘（cf. inter埋葬，exhume挖掘） || 文化联想：考古工作中依法起出墓葬遗骸最适合帮助记忆 disinter，可以说 **disinter remains — “Archaeologists may disinter remains carefully when a burial site must be studied or relocated.”**

quiz.question: saunter _____
quiz.explanation: 漫步; 闲逛, 沿着...漫步. They would saunter along the beach at sunset. 他们会在日落时沿着海滩漫步。 | saunter->漫步（可能来自sainte terre->圣地，朝圣者悠然而行），saunter->悠然漫步（cf. stroll散步，amble缓行） || 文化联想：晚饭后沿西湖慢慢散步最适合帮助记忆 saunter，可以说 **saunter along the lake — “After dinner, visitors may saunter along the lake and enjoy the evening breeze.”**

quiz.question: ______ encounter
quiz.explanation: 遭遇; 邂逅, 偶然相遇. Their chance encounter at the airport led to a friendship. 他们在机场的偶然相遇促成了一段友谊。 | en->朝向，counter->对面/相对，encounter->面对面碰上=邂逅/遭遇（cf. counter柜台，counter反驳） || 文化联想：中文“偶遇”最适合帮助记忆 encounter，可以说 **a chance encounter — “A chance encounter with an old classmate at a railway station may revive a friendship after many years.”**

quiz.question: ________ scooter
quiz.explanation: 踏板车, 电动踏板车. Many commuters now use an electric scooter to get to work. 许多通勤者现在使用电动踏板车上班。 | scoot->快速溜走（象声词），scooter->快速移动的车=踏板车（cf. scuttle匆忙，scurry疾跑） || 文化联想：中国城市短途通勤常见电动滑板车，最适合帮助记忆 scooter，可以说 **an electric scooter — “A commuter may use an electric scooter for the last kilometer between a station and the office.”**

quiz.question: _________ charter
quiz.explanation: 宪章; 章程, 公司章程. The corporate charter defines the company's purpose and structure. 公司章程规定了公司的宗旨和结构。 | charta->纸/文件（拉丁），charter->重要的书面文件=宪章（cf. chart图表，carte blanche全权委托） || 文化联想：中国公司注册时需要明确章程，最适合帮助记忆 charter，可以说 **a corporate charter — “A corporate charter sets out a company’s legal identity, purpose, and basic governance structure.”**

quiz.question: ____ deserter
quiz.explanation: 逃兵; 开小差者, 军队逃兵. The army deserter was caught and court-martialed. 军队逃兵被抓获并受到军事法庭审判。 | de->离开，sert->连接/部队，deserter->离开部队的人=逃兵（cf. desert沙漠/抛弃，dessert甜点，注意区分） || 文化联想：古代战争中逃离军队的逃兵最适合帮助记忆 deserter，可以说 **an army deserter — “A soldier who abandons the army without permission during wartime may be treated as an army deserter.”**

quiz.question: alabaster ____
quiz.explanation: 雪花石膏; 雪白的, 雪白的皮肤. The actress was admired for her alabaster skin. 这位女演员因其雪白的皮肤而受到赞赏。 | alabastros->埃及产白色石膏（希腊），alabaster->雪花石膏/洁白如石膏的（cf. alabastrine白如石膏的） || 文化联想：古装剧里“肤如凝脂、白如美玉”的描写最适合帮助记忆 alabaster，可以说 **alabaster skin — “A classical-style portrait may describe a noblewoman as having smooth, alabaster skin.”**

quiz.question: plaster ____
quiz.explanation: 石膏; 灰泥, 石膏墙. The contractor repaired the cracked plaster wall. 承包商修复了开裂的石膏墙。 | emplastron->涂抹物（希腊），plaster->涂抹于墙上的灰泥（cf. alabaster白石膏，plaster cast石膏模型） || 文化联想：中国老房子墙面开裂后重新抹灰最适合帮助记忆 plaster，可以说 **a plaster wall — “A contractor repairing an old apartment may patch cracks in a plaster wall before repainting it.”**

quiz.question: _____ daubster
quiz.explanation: 拙劣的画家, 无能的拙劣画家. The critic dismissed him as an inept daubster with no talent. 评论家认为他是一个没有才华的无能的拙劣画家。 | daub->粗糙地涂抹（古法语dauber->涂白灰），daubster->粗糙涂抹的人=拙劣画家（cf. dauber涂抹者） || 文化联想：中文“只会乱涂乱画的蹩脚画家”最适合帮助记忆 daubster，可以说 **an inept daubster — “A critic may dismiss someone who merely smears paint without skill as an inept daubster.”**

quiz.question: _____ fester
quiz.explanation: 化脓; 溃烂, 伤口化脓. If left untreated, the wound fester and become infected. 如果不治疗,伤口化脓并感染。 | fistula->管状脓疮（拉丁），fester->化脓腐烂（cf. festering积怨=情绪的化脓，fistula瘘管） || 文化联想：中文“伤口化脓、拖着不治越来越糟”最适合帮助记忆 fester，可以说 **let a wound fester — “Ignoring an infected cut can let a wound fester and become much more serious.”**

quiz.question: pester ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 纠缠; 烦扰, 用电话纠缠. Telemarketers would pester with calls during dinner time. 电话推销员会在晚餐时间用电话纠缠。 | empestrer->用绳子绊住（法语），pester->像被绳子绊住一样=纠缠（cf. fester化脓，bother打扰） || 文化联想：中文“电话骚扰、没完没了地纠缠”最适合帮助记忆 pester，可以说 **pester with calls — “Repeated sales calls during dinner may pester a household until the number is blocked.”**

quiz.question: sequester ______
quiz.explanation: 隔离; 扣押, 扣押资产. The court ordered authorities to sequester assets of the defendant. 法院命令当局扣押被告的资产。 | sequi->跟随（拉丁），sequester->随托管人而去=隔离/扣押（cf. sequence序列，consequence后果） || 文化联想：法院冻结涉案财产最适合帮助记忆 sequester，可以说 **sequester assets — “A court may order authorities to sequester assets so they cannot be moved while a case is pending.”**

quiz.question: sinister ______
quiz.explanation: 邪恶的; 不祥的, 邪恶的动机. The detective suspected a sinister motive behind the crime. 侦探怀疑犯罪背后有邪恶的动机。 | sinister->左边的（拉丁，古罗马认为左边是凶兆），sinister->不祥的/邪恶的（cf. dexter右边/灵巧的，ambidextrous两手灵巧） || 文化联想：古装悬疑剧里“背后另有阴险动机”最适合帮助记忆 sinister，可以说 **a sinister motive — “A detective may suspect a sinister motive when an apparently harmless act benefits someone secretly.”**

quiz.question: _____ cloister
quiz.explanation: 修道院回廊; 使隐居, 安静的修道院. The monks lived in a quiet cloister away from the world. 僧侣们生活在远离世界的安静修道院中。 | claustrum->关闭的地方（拉丁claudere->关），cloister->关闭起来的地方=修道院（cf. close关闭，closet壁橱，clause条款） || 文化联想：cloister 是西方修道院回廊，可用中国游客参观欧洲古修道院的场景来记忆，可以说 **a quiet cloister — “A Chinese traveler visiting an old European monastery may walk through a quiet cloister surrounding an inner courtyard.”**

quiz.question: roister ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 狂欢; 喧闹, 整夜狂欢. The revelers would roister all night during the festival. 狂欢者会在节日期间整夜狂欢。 | rustre->粗鲁的乡下人（古法语），roister->喧闹狂欢（cf. roister-doister吵闹鬼，cloister修道院） || 文化联想：春节酒席后年轻人通宵喧闹庆祝的场面可以帮助记忆 roister，可以说 **roister all night — “A noisy group celebrating a major victory may roister all night in restaurants and bars.”**

quiz.question: _____'_ barrister
quiz.explanation: 出庭律师(英国), 王室大律师. The Queen's barrister presented the case in court. 王室大律师在法庭上陈述案件。 | bar->律师席/栏，barrister->有资格越过律师席的人=出庭律师（cf. bar律师界，disbar取消律师资格） || 文化联想：barrister 是英格兰等法律体系中的出庭律师，可用中国法学生学习英国法律职业来记忆，可以说 **a senior barrister — “A Chinese law student studying the British system may learn that a senior barrister specializes in courtroom advocacy.”**

quiz.question: ______ huckster
quiz.explanation: 小贩; 叫卖者, 街头叫卖者. The street huckster sold knockoff merchandise to tourists. 街头叫卖者向游客出售仿冒商品。 | hoker->小贩（荷兰语），huckster->贩卖廉价商品的小贩（cf. hawk叫卖，hawker小贩） || 文化联想：老街旅游区里向游客兜售小商品的小贩最适合帮助记忆 huckster，可以说 **a street huckster — “A street huckster may loudly offer cheap souvenirs to tourists passing through a busy market.”**

quiz.question: pollster ______
quiz.explanation: 民意调查员, 民意调查. The pollster survey revealed changing public opinion. 民意调查显示公众意见正在改变。 | poll->计票/头，pollster->进行计票调查的人=民调员（cf. poll民调，polling station投票站） || 文化联想：中文“民调专家”最适合帮助记忆 pollster，可以说 **a professional pollster — “A professional pollster may survey a representative sample to estimate public opinion.”**

quiz.question: bolster __________
quiz.explanation: 支撑; 鼓励, 增强信心. The coach's words helped bolster confidence in the team. 教练的话帮助增强了团队的信心。 | bolster->长枕/支撑（古英语）,bolster->像枕头一样支撑=增强（cf. bolster up支撑，shoulder承担） || 文化联想：中文“给团队打气、增强信心”最适合帮助记忆 bolster，可以说 **bolster confidence — “A coach’s calm encouragement can bolster confidence before an important final.”**

quiz.question: ___ holster
quiz.explanation: 枪套, 枪套. The officer drew his weapon from the gun holster. 警官从枪套中拔出武器。 | holster->枪套（荷兰语holster->皮套），holster->枪的皮套（cf. holster在电影中常见，draw from holster拔枪） || 文化联想：holster 是枪套，可用警匪影视中的腰间枪套来记忆，可以说 **a gun holster — “In a police drama, an officer may secure a sidearm in a gun holster attached to the belt.”**

quiz.question: foster ____
quiz.explanation: 培养; 收养, 寄养. The child was placed in foster care after the incident. 事件发生后,孩子被安置在寄养家庭。 | foster->喂养（古英语fostrian），foster->养育/培养（cf. foster child养子，nurture培育） || 文化联想：中文“寄养家庭”最适合帮助记忆 foster，可以说 **foster care — “A child who cannot safely remain at home may temporarily enter foster care with an approved family.”**

quiz.question: _____ poster
quiz.explanation: 海报, 电影海报. The vintage movie poster sold for thousands at auction. 这张老式电影海报在拍卖会上以数千美元成交。 | post->柱子/张贴，poster->张贴在柱上的=海报（cf. post邮寄，posting张贴，postcard明信片） || 文化联想：中国电影院门口的大幅电影海报最适合帮助记忆 poster，可以说 **a movie poster — “A cinema lobby may display a large movie poster advertising the newest holiday release.”**

quiz.question: four-poster ___
quiz.explanation: 四柱床, 四柱床. The master bedroom featured an antique four-poster bed. 主卧室配有一张古董四柱床。 | four->四，poster->柱子，four-poster->四根柱子支撑的=四柱床（cf. poster海报，post柱子） || 文化联想：民国老宅或欧式老饭店里的四柱床最适合帮助记忆 four-poster，可以说 **a four-poster bed — “A restored historic hotel may furnish a room with an antique four-poster bed surrounded by curtains.”**

quiz.question: ____ roster
quiz.explanation: 名册; 花名册, 团队名册. The coach announced changes to the team roster. 教练宣布了团队名册的变化。 | rooster->烤架（荷兰语rooster），roster->像烤架格子一样排列的名单=名册（cf. roost栖息，rooster公鸡） || 文化联想：中国国家队公布参赛名单最适合帮助记忆 roster，可以说 **a team roster — “Before an international tournament, the coach announces the final team roster.”**

quiz.question: ______ _ filibuster
quiz.explanation: 阻挠议事; 冗长演说, 发起阻挠议事. Senators threatened to launch a filibuster against the bill. 参议员们威胁要对该法案发起阻挠议事。 | vrijbuiter->自由劫掠者（荷兰语），filibuster->像海盗一样劫持议程=冗长演说阻挠议事（cf. freebooter劫掠者） || 文化联想：filibuster 是美国等议会中的阻挠议事手段，可用中国学生学习美国政治制度时来记忆，可以说 **launch a filibuster — “In a class on U.S. politics, Chinese students may learn how senators can try to launch a filibuster to delay legislation.”**

quiz.question: _____ cluster
quiz.explanation: 串; 群, 葡萄串. She picked a ripe grape cluster from the vine. 她从藤上摘下一串成熟的葡萄。 | cluster->聚集（古英语clyster），cluster->紧密聚集的一群/一串（cf. clump树丛，clutter杂乱） || 文化联想：新疆葡萄架上一串成熟葡萄最适合帮助记忆 cluster，可以说 **a grape cluster — “A farmer in Xinjiang may cut a ripe grape cluster from the vine during harvest.”**

quiz.question: lackluster ___________
quiz.explanation: 无光泽的; 平淡的, 平淡的表现. The team's lackluster performance disappointed the fans. 球队平淡的表现让球迷失望。 | lack->缺乏，luster->光泽，lackluster->缺乏光泽的=平淡无奇的（cf. illustrious卓越的=照亮的，lustre光泽） || 文化联想：中文“发挥平平、毫无亮点”最适合帮助记忆 lackluster，可以说 **a lackluster performance — “A heavily favored team that plays without energy may deliver a lackluster performance and disappoint its fans.”**

quiz.question: scatter _____
quiz.explanation: 分散; 撒播, 撒播种子. The farmer would scatter seeds across the field. 农民会在田野里撒播种子。 | scatter->分散（古挪威skattr），scatter->向四处撒去（cf. shatter打碎，clatter哗啦声，splatter飞溅） || 文化联想：中国农民撒播油菜或草籽最适合帮助记忆 scatter，可以说 **scatter seeds — “A farmer may scatter seeds evenly across prepared soil before covering them lightly.”**

quiz.question: enfetter ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 束缚; 加枷锁, 束缚思想. Rigid traditions can enfetter the mind and limit creativity. 僵化的传统会束缚思想并限制创造力。 | en->使，fetter->脚镣（古英语fetor），enfetter->给...戴上脚镣=束缚（cf. fetter脚镣，letter字母，同形联想） || 文化联想：中文“思想被条条框框束缚”最适合帮助记忆 enfetter，可以说 **enfetter the mind — “Rigid rules that forbid questioning can enfetter the mind and limit creativity.”**

quiz.question: embitter _________
quiz.explanation: 使痛苦; 使怨恨, 使关系恶化. The dispute would embitter relations between the two nations. 这场争端会使两国关系恶化。 | em->使，bitter->苦，embitter->使变苦/使怨恨（cf. bitter苦的，bitterness苦涩/怨恨） || 文化联想：中文“让两家的关系越来越苦、心生怨恨”最适合帮助记忆 embitter，可以说 **embitter relations — “A long dispute over money can embitter relations between two families that were once close.”**

quiz.question: _______ jitter
quiz.explanation: 紧张不安, 紧张不安. She felt nervous jitter before the important presentation. 她在重要演讲前感到紧张不安。 | jitter->颤抖（象声词），jitters->紧张不安（give someone the jitters->使某人紧张，cf. jittery紧张的） || 文化联想：高考或重要演讲前“紧张得发抖”最适合帮助记忆 jitter，可以说 **a nervous jitter — “Just before walking onto the stage, a student may feel a nervous jitter in the hands and stomach.”**

quiz.question: litter ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 垃圾; 乱扔, 在街上乱扔垃圾. Please don't litter the street with trash. 请不要在街上乱扔垃圾。 | lit->床/垫子（拉丁lectus），litter->原指床草垫，后指散乱的垃圾（cf. litter一窝幼崽，literally字面上） || 文化联想：中国城市街头“请勿乱扔垃圾”的标语最适合帮助记忆 litter，可以说 **litter the street — “A sign reading ‘请勿乱扔垃圾’ reminds pedestrians not to litter the street with cups, wrappers, or cigarette butts.”**

quiz.question: _______ glitter
quiz.explanation: 闪光; 闪耀, 钻石闪光. The diamond glitter caught everyone's attention at the gala. 钻石闪光在晚会上吸引了所有人的注意。 | glitter->闪光（古挪威glitra），glitter->闪闪发光（All that glitters is not gold->闪光的不都是金子） || 文化联想：春节灯会里金粉和灯饰闪闪发光的画面最适合帮助记忆 glitter，可以说 **festive glitter — “At a Spring Festival lantern fair, gold decorations and bright lights can fill the street with festive glitter.”**

quiz.question: ___ otter
quiz.explanation: 水獭, 海獭. The sea otter floated on its back eating shellfish. 海獭仰面漂浮着吃贝类。 | otter->水獭（古英语otor），otter->水獭（cf. water水，otter与water同源，水中的动物） || 文化联想：中国动物园或湿地里水獭仰面漂浮的样子最适合帮助记忆 otter，可以说 **a playful otter — “Visitors at a wildlife park may watch a playful otter float on its back and crack food with its paws.”**

quiz.question: utter ________
quiz.explanation: 完全的; 说出, 完全的胡说. His speech was utter nonsense from beginning to end. 他的演讲从头到尾都是完全的胡说。 | utter->外部的/完全的（古英语utera->外面的），utter->彻底的/说出（cf. outer外部的，utterly完全地） || 文化联想：中文“胡说八道”最适合帮助记忆 utter，可以说 **utter nonsense — “A rumor with no evidence and no internal logic can be dismissed as utter nonsense—‘胡说八道.’”**

quiz.question: scutter ___
quiz.explanation: 急忙跑开, 急忙跑开. The mouse would scutter off when it heard footsteps. 老鼠听到脚步声就会急忙跑开。 | scutter->急速奔跑（scatter的变体），scutter off->慌忙逃走（cf. scurry疾跑，scatter四散） || 文化联想：老鼠一听见脚步声就飞快窜走的画面最适合帮助记忆 scutter，可以说 **scutter off — “A mouse in an old courtyard may scutter off the moment it hears footsteps.”**

quiz.question: ____ gutter
quiz.explanation: 排水沟; 贫民窟, 雨水排水沟. The rain gutter needs cleaning before the storm season. 雨水排水沟需要在暴风雨季节前清理。 | gutta->水滴（拉丁），gutter->汇集水滴的槽=排水沟（cf. guttural喉音的，gout痛风=关节积液） || 文化联想：南方暴雨前清理屋檐排水槽最适合帮助记忆 gutter，可以说 **a rain gutter — “Before the rainy season, a homeowner may clear leaves from a rain gutter so water can drain properly.”**

quiz.question: beleaguer ____
quiz.explanation: 围困; 困扰, 围困城市. Enemy forces continued to beleaguer city for months. 敌军继续围困城市数月。 | be->使，leaguer->营地/包围（荷兰leger->军营），beleaguer->用军营围住=围困（cf. league联盟，beleaguered被围困的） || 文化联想：古代战争中的“围城”最适合帮助记忆 beleaguer，可以说 **beleaguer a city — “An invading army may beleaguer a city for months by surrounding its walls and cutting supply routes.”**

quiz.question: ________ exchequer
quiz.explanation: 国库; 财政部, 国库. The national exchequer faced serious budget deficits. 国库面临严重的预算赤字。 | eschec->棋盘（古法语，来自波斯Shah->国王），exchequer->用格子布算账的地方=国库（cf. chess国际象棋，check支票） || 文化联想：中文“国库”最适合帮助记忆 exchequer，可以说 **the national exchequer — “A large emergency program can place heavy pressure on the national exchequer if spending rises faster than revenue.”**

quiz.question: conquer ____
quiz.explanation: 征服; 克服, 克服恐惧. She worked hard to conquer fear of public speaking. 她努力克服对公开演讲的恐惧。 | con->完全，quer->寻求/征服（拉丁quaerere），conquer->完全征服（cf. query疑问，conquest征服） || 文化联想：中文“战胜恐惧”最适合帮助记忆 conquer，可以说 **conquer fear — “A student who practices speaking repeatedly may gradually conquer fear of giving a presentation in public.”**

quiz.question: aver ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 断言; 声明, 断言真相. The witness would aver the truth under oath. 证人会在宣誓下断言真相。 | a->朝向，ver->真（拉丁verus），aver->宣称真相=断言（cf. verify证实，verdict裁决，verisimilar逼真的） || 文化联想：中文“据实断言”最适合帮助记忆 aver，可以说 **aver the truth — “A witness who is certain of what was seen may aver the truth clearly under oath.”**

quiz.question: _____ cadaver
quiz.explanation: 尸体, 人类尸体. Medical students studied anatomy using a human cadaver. 医学生使用人类尸体学习解剖学。 | cadere->倒下（拉丁），cadaver->倒下的人=尸体（cf. cadaverous骨瘦如柴的，cadence节奏=落下的节拍） || 文化联想：中国医学院解剖课最适合帮助记忆 cadaver，可以说 **a human cadaver — “Medical students may study anatomy with a human cadaver under strict ethical and laboratory rules.”**

quiz.question: ____ cleaver
quiz.explanation: 切肉刀, 切肉刀. The butcher used a sharp meat cleaver to cut the beef. 屠夫用锋利的切肉刀切牛肉。 | cleave->劈开（古英语cleofan），cleaver->用来劈开的刀=切肉刀（cleave一词两义：劈开/紧附，cf. cling紧附） || 文化联想：中国菜市场肉铺里的厚重切肉刀最适合帮助记忆 cleaver，可以说 **a meat cleaver — “A butcher may use a heavy meat cleaver to cut through a large piece of pork or beef.”**

quiz.question: ____ palaver
quiz.explanation: 冗长的谈话; 闲谈, 冗长的谈话. After a long palaver, they finally reached an agreement. 经过冗长的谈话,他们终于达成了协议。 | palavra->话语（葡萄牙语，来自拉丁parabola），palaver->（非洲贸易中）与土著的谈判=冗长谈话（cf. parable寓言） || 文化联想：中文“长篇大论、绕来绕去”最适合帮助记忆 palaver，可以说 **a long palaver — “After a long palaver about minor details, the two sides may finally return to the main issue.”**

quiz.question: slaver ____
quiz.explanation: 流口水; 奴隶贩子, 对...垂涎. The dog would slaver over the delicious treat. 狗会对美味的食物垂涎。 | slaver->流口水（古挪威slafra），slaver->垂涎/奴隶贩子（cf. slobber流口水，drool垂涎） || 文化联想：中文“垂涎三尺”最适合帮助记忆 slaver，可以说 **slaver over food — “A hungry dog smelling roast meat may slaver over the food—让人联想到‘垂涎三尺.’”**

quiz.question: _______ lever
quiz.explanation: 杠杆; 撬杠, 撬杠杠杆. He used a crowbar lever to pry open the crate. 他用撬杠杠杆撬开了板条箱。 | lever->举起（拉丁levare->减轻），lever->用来举起的工具=杠杆（cf. levity轻浮，elevate举起，relieve减轻） || 文化联想：“四两拨千斤”最适合帮助记忆 lever，可以说 **use a lever — “A worker can use a lever to move a heavy stone with much less force—很像‘四两拨千斤.’”**

quiz.question: ____-___ diver
quiz.explanation: 潜水员, 深海潜水员. The deep-sea diver explored the ocean floor for treasure. 深海潜水员在海底寻找宝藏。 | dive->潜入（古英语dyfan），diver->潜水的人=潜水员（cf. dive俯冲，dive-bomb俯冲轰炸） || 文化联想：中国海洋科考中的深海潜水员最适合帮助记忆 diver，可以说 **a deep-sea diver — “A deep-sea diver may descend from a research vessel to inspect equipment or collect samples below the surface.”**

quiz.question: ____ screwdriver
quiz.explanation: 螺丝刀, 平头螺丝刀. Use a flat screwdriver to remove the cover plate. 使用平头螺丝刀拆下盖板。 | screw->螺丝，driver->驱动者，screwdriver->驱动螺丝的工具=螺丝刀（也是伏特加+橙汁的鸡尾酒名） || 文化联想：家里拆插座面板或修家具时用平头螺丝刀最适合帮助记忆 screwdriver，可以说 **a flat screwdriver — “A homeowner may use a flat screwdriver to loosen a slotted screw on an old fixture.”**

quiz.question: gloss-over _______
quiz.explanation: 掩饰; 粉饰, 掩饰问题. Don't gloss-over problem just because it's uncomfortable. 不要仅仅因为不舒服就掩饰问题。 | gloss->光泽/注释，gloss over->用光泽掩盖=粉饰/掩饰（cf. glossary词汇表，gloss解释） || 文化联想：中文“粉饰太平”最适合帮助记忆 gloss-over，可以说 **gloss over a problem — “A report that hides serious defects behind cheerful language may gloss over a problem—近似‘粉饰太平.’”**

quiz.question: ____ layover
quiz.explanation: 中途停留, 长时间中途停留. We had a long layover in Chicago before our connecting flight. 我们在芝加哥有一个长时间中途停留,然后转机。 | lay->放置/停下，over->结束，layover->在途中停留=中途停留（cf. stopover中途停留，layoff裁员） || 文化联想：中国旅客国际转机时在机场停留数小时最适合帮助记忆 layover，可以说 **a long layover — “A traveler flying from China to another continent may have a long layover at an international hub before the connecting flight.”**

quiz.question: ________ maneuver
quiz.explanation: 演习; 策略, 军事演习. The troops conducted a military maneuver in the desert. 部队在沙漠中进行了军事演习。 | manu->手，ouvrer->操作（法语），maneuver->用手操作=策略（cf. manual手册，manufacture制造，manure肥料=用手耕作） || 文化联想：《三十六计》里的调动和佯动最适合帮助记忆 maneuver，可以说 **a military maneuver — “A commander may use a military maneuver to shift troops and mislead an opponent about the real direction of attack.”**

quiz.question: outmaneuver __ ________
quiz.explanation: 以策略胜过, 智胜对手. The chess player managed to outmaneuver an opponent. 国际象棋选手设法智胜对手。 | out->超过，maneuver->策略，outmaneuver->在策略上超过=智胜（cf. outfox以智取胜，outflanking迂回） || 文化联想：围棋里通过布局和计算智胜对手最适合帮助记忆 outmaneuver，可以说 **outmaneuver an opponent — “A strong Go player may outmaneuver an opponent by creating threats in one area while gaining territory in another.”**

quiz.question: skewer ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 串肉扦; 刺穿, 驳斥论点. The debater used facts to skewer the argument completely. 辩论者用事实彻底驳斥了论点。 | skewer->串肉扦（来源不明），skewer->用扦串穿/驳斥（cf. pierce刺穿，skewered被串穿=被彻底驳斥） || 文化联想：中文“一针见血地驳倒论点”最适合帮助记忆 skewer，可以说 **skewer an argument — “One well-chosen fact can skewer an argument that depends on a false assumption—像‘一针见血.’”**

quiz.question: _____ bower
quiz.explanation: 凉亭; 树荫处, 绿叶凉亭. They sat in the leafy bower enjoying the shade. 他们坐在绿叶凉亭里享受阴凉。 | bur->小屋（古英语）,bower->树叶覆盖的小屋=凉亭（cf. boudoir闺房，neighbour邻居=附近的农舍） || 文化联想：苏州园林里藤蔓和树荫覆盖的凉亭最适合帮助记忆 bower，可以说 **a leafy bower — “A shaded corner of a Suzhou garden may form a leafy bower where visitors can sit beside bamboo and water.”**

quiz.question: empower _____
quiz.explanation: 授权; 使能够, 赋权妇女. Education programs aim to empower women in developing countries. 教育项目旨在赋权发展中国家的妇女。 | em->使，power->力量，empower->使拥有力量=赋权（cf. embolden使大胆，enable使能够） || 文化联想：“妇女能顶半边天”最适合帮助记忆 empower，可以说 **empower women — “Expanding education and employment opportunities can empower women—让‘妇女能顶半边天’成为更现实的社会能力.”**

quiz.question: bricklayer __________
quiz.explanation: 砌砖工, 砌砖工学徒. The bricklayer apprentice learned the trade from a master. 砌砖工学徒向师傅学习这门手艺。 | brick->砖，layer->铺放者，bricklayer->铺砖的人=砌砖工（cf. lay放置，layer层） || 文化联想：中国传统建筑工地里“师傅带徒弟”的砌砖学徒最适合帮助记忆 bricklayer，可以说 **a bricklayer apprentice — “A bricklayer apprentice may learn from a master how to spread mortar, align bricks, and keep a wall level.”**

quiz.question: _______ naysayer
quiz.explanation: 反对者; 否定者, 长期反对者. The chronic naysayer opposed every new proposal. 长期反对者反对每一个新提议。 | nay->不/否（古英语nei），sayer->说话者，naysayer->说不的人=反对者（cf. nay古英语的no，yea古英语的yes） || 文化联想：中文“逢事必反、什么都说不行”最适合帮助记忆 naysayer，可以说 **a chronic naysayer — “Someone who rejects every new proposal before hearing the details may become a chronic naysayer.”**

quiz.question: _____ foyer
quiz.explanation: 门厅; 休息室, 酒店门厅. Guests gathered in the hotel foyer before dinner. 客人们在晚餐前聚集在酒店门厅。 | foyer->火炉（法语，拉丁focus->壁炉），foyer->火炉旁的休息处=门厅（cf. focus焦点=壁炉，fuel燃料） || 文化联想：中国大酒店入口处宽敞的大堂最适合帮助记忆 foyer，可以说 **a hotel foyer — “Guests may wait in the hotel foyer before a wedding banquet begins.”**

quiz.question: ________ flair
quiz.explanation: 天赋; 才华, 艺术天赋. She decorated her home with artistic flair and creativity. 她以艺术天赋和创造力装饰了她的家。 | flair->嗅出（法语，来自拉丁fragrare->散发香气），flair->嗅觉/天赋=才能（cf. fragrant芬芳的） || 文化联想：书法家挥毫时展现出的独特艺术气质最适合帮助记忆 flair，可以说 **artistic flair — “A calligrapher may show artistic flair through distinctive brush pressure, rhythm, and spacing.”**

quiz.question: debonair _____
quiz.explanation: 温文尔雅的; 潇洒的, 潇洒的魅力. His debonair charm made him popular at social events. 他潇洒的魅力使他在社交活动中很受欢迎。 | de bon aire->有好气质（古法语），debonair->有良好气质的=潇洒的（cf. bon好，air气质/空气） || 文化联想：民国老上海西装革履、谈吐从容的绅士形象最适合帮助记忆 debonair，可以说 **debonair charm — “A well-dressed gentleman in an old Shanghai photograph may project debonair charm through relaxed confidence and polished manners.”**

quiz.question: impair ______
quiz.explanation: 损害; 削弱, 损害视力. Excessive screen time can impair vision over time. 过度使用屏幕会随着时间损害视力。 | im->否定，pair->相等/完整，impair->使不完整=损害（cf. repair修复=重新使完整，pair一对） || 文化联想：中文“损害视力”最适合帮助记忆 impair，可以说 **impair vision — “A serious eye injury can impair vision and make ordinary reading or driving difficult.”**

quiz.question: _____ nadir
quiz.explanation: 最低点; 天底, 达到最低点. The company's fortunes would reach nadir during the recession. 该公司的财富在经济衰退期间达到最低点。 | nadir->正对脚下的点（阿拉伯语nazir->对应），nadir->天底/最低点（cf. zenith天顶/最高点，两者相对） || 文化联想：中文“跌到谷底”最适合帮助记忆 nadir，可以说 **reach the nadir — “A company whose sales and cash flow collapse may reach the nadir of its business cycle—跌到‘谷底.’”**

quiz.question: ______ souvenir
quiz.explanation: 纪念品, 旅行纪念品. She bought a travel souvenir from every country she visited. 她从访问的每个国家都买了一个旅行纪念品。 | souvenir->记住（法语，来自拉丁subvenire->涌上心头），souvenir->唤起记忆的物品=纪念品（cf. subvention补助） || 文化联想：故宫、兵马俑等景点买的小纪念品最适合帮助记忆 souvenir，可以说 **a travel souvenir — “A visitor may buy a small Forbidden City magnet as a travel souvenir to remember the trip.”**

quiz.question: ______ choir
quiz.explanation: 合唱团, 教堂合唱团. The church choir sang beautifully during the service. 教堂合唱团在礼拜期间唱得很美。 | chorus->合唱（希腊），choir->合唱团（注意ch发k音，cf. chorus合唱，choral合唱的，choreography编舞） || 文化联想：choir 是西方合唱传统常见词，可用中国教堂礼拜中的唱诗班来记忆，可以说 **a church choir — “At a church in China, a church choir may sing hymns during a Sunday service.”**

quiz.question: memoir ______
quiz.explanation: 回忆录, 回忆录作家. The memoir writer recounted her childhood experiences. 回忆录作家讲述了她的童年经历。 | memoire->记忆（法语），memoir->记忆的书写=回忆录（cf. memory记忆，memorial纪念碑，memorize记忆） || 文化联想：老兵或老教师把一生经历写成回忆录最适合帮助记忆 memoir，可以说 **write a memoir — “A retired teacher may write a memoir describing childhood, work, family, and decades of social change.”**

quiz.question: elixir __ ____
quiz.explanation: 灵丹妙药; 长生不老药, 生命之药. Ancient alchemists searched for the elixir of life. 古代炼金术士寻找生命之药。 | al-iksir->干燥粉末（阿拉伯语，来自希腊xerion->干燥剂），elixir->炼金术士的神奇药剂（cf. dry干燥，alchemy炼金术） || 文化联想：秦始皇求长生不老药的传说最适合帮助记忆 elixir，可以说 **the elixir of life — “Legends about ancient rulers searching for immortality make the phrase the elixir of life especially memorable.”**

quiz.question: belabor ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 过分详述; 反复说明, 反复强调要点. Don't belabor the point; we understand your argument. 不要反复强调要点,我们理解你的论点。 | be->使，labor->劳动/过度努力，belabor->过度劳动于=反复强调（cf. labor劳动，elaborate详细阐述） || 文化联想：中文“翻来覆去讲同一个点”最适合帮助记忆 belabor，可以说 **belabor the point — “Once everyone understands the issue, repeating the same explanation for another twenty minutes is to belabor the point.”**

quiz.question: harbor _ ______
quiz.explanation: 港口; 怀有, 怀恨在心. It's unhealthy to harbor a grudge for years. 多年怀恨在心是不健康的。 | heriberga->军队庇护所（古英语），harbor->给予庇护/暗中藏有（cf. harbinger先驱，harbour英式拼写） || 文化联想：中文“怀恨在心”最适合帮助记忆 harbor，可以说 **harbor a grudge — “Two relatives who refuse to forgive an old inheritance dispute may harbor a grudge for years.”**

quiz.question: _____ succor
quiz.explanation: 救援; 援助, 提供援助. The charity organization would offer succor to disaster victims. 慈善组织会向灾民提供援助。 | sub->从下，curr->跑（拉丁），succor->跑来相助=援助（cf. occur发生，incur招致，recur复发） || 文化联想：“雪中送炭”最适合帮助记忆 succor，可以说 **offer succor — “Bringing food, medicine, and shelter to families after a flood is to offer succor—很像‘雪中送炭.’”**

quiz.question: ____ rancor
quiz.explanation: 怨恨; 仇恨, 深仇大恨. Deep rancor divided the two families for generations. 深仇大恨使两个家族分裂了几代人。 | rancere->腐烂发臭（拉丁），rancor->腐烂的积怨=长期的仇恨（cf. rancid腐臭的，rancorous怀恨的） || 文化联想：中文“世代积怨、深仇大恨”最适合帮助记忆 rancor，可以说 **deep rancor — “A dispute passed down through generations can leave deep rancor between two families.”**

quiz.question: ____________ matador
quiz.explanation: 斗牛士, 斗牛士. The bullfighting matador entered the arena to cheers. 斗牛士在欢呼声中进入竞技场。 | matar->杀死（西班牙语，拉丁mactare），matador->杀牛者=斗牛士（cf. checkmate将死，mate伴侣/杀死） || 文化联想：matador 是西班牙斗牛文化中的斗牛士，可用中国学生学习西班牙文化时来记忆，可以说 **a bullfighting matador — “In a lesson on Spanish culture, Chinese students may learn that a bullfighting matador performs in the arena during a traditional bullfight.”**

quiz.question: candor ___ _________
quiz.explanation: 坦率; 直率, 坦率和真诚. She spoke with candor and sincerity about her mistakes. 她坦率和真诚地谈论了她的错误。 | candor->白/纯洁（拉丁candidus->白色），candor->像白色一样纯洁=坦率（cf. candid坦率的，candidate候选人=穿白袍者） || 文化联想：中文“打开天窗说亮话”最适合帮助记忆 candor，可以说 **speak with candor — “Someone who admits mistakes and explains the facts directly is speaking with candor—真正‘打开天窗说亮话.’”**

quiz.question: _____ splendor
quiz.explanation: 壮丽; 辉煌, 皇家辉煌. The palace displayed royal splendor in every detail. 宫殿的每个细节都展现了皇家辉煌。 | splendere->闪耀（拉丁），splendor->闪耀的光辉=壮丽（cf. splendid壮丽的，resplendent光辉灿烂的） || 文化联想：故宫太和殿的皇家气象最适合帮助记忆 splendor，可以说 **imperial splendor — “The vast courtyards, red walls, and ceremonial halls of the Forbidden City convey imperial splendor.”**

quiz.question: ______ condor
quiz.explanation: 秃鹰, 安第斯秃鹰. The Andean condor is one of the largest flying birds. 安第斯秃鹰是最大的飞鸟之一。 | cuntur->秃鹰（克丘亚语，南美原住民语），condor->安第斯山脉的巨型秃鹰 || 文化联想：condor 是南美安第斯大型秃鹰，可用中国动物园或纪录片语境来记忆，可以说 **an Andean condor — “Chinese viewers watching a wildlife documentary may see an Andean condor soaring above the mountains on broad wings.”**

quiz.question: malodor _______
quiz.explanation: 恶臭, 恶臭问题. The building had a persistent malodor problem. 这栋建筑有持续的恶臭问题。 | mal->坏，odor->气味（拉丁odor），malodor->坏气味=恶臭（cf. odorous有气味的，deodorant除臭剂） || 文化联想：夏天下水道堵塞后冒出的恶臭最适合帮助记忆 malodor，可以说 **a persistent malodor — “A blocked drain can create a persistent malodor that spreads through an alley.”**

quiz.question: ________ rigor
quiz.explanation: 严格; 严谨, 学术严谨. The program is known for its academic rigor and high standards. 该项目以其学术严谨和高标准而闻名。 | rigor->僵硬/严格（拉丁rigere->僵硬），rigor->严格（rigor mortis->死亡僵硬，cf. rigid僵硬的） || 文化联想：中文“治学严谨”最适合帮助记忆 rigor，可以说 **academic rigor — “A strong research paper shows academic rigor through careful evidence, precise reasoning, and transparent methods.”**

quiz.question: abhor ________
quiz.explanation: 憎恶; 厌恶, 憎恶暴力. Most civilized societies abhor violence in all forms. 大多数文明社会憎恶各种形式的暴力。 | ab->离开，hor->恐惧（拉丁horrere），abhor->因恐惧而退避=憎恶（cf. horror恐惧，horrible可怕的，abhorrent令人憎恶的） || 文化联想：“以和为贵”可以反衬对暴力的厌恶，最适合帮助记忆 abhor，可以说 **abhor violence — “A person who believes disputes should be settled peacefully may abhor violence in every form.”**

quiz.question: ____ anchor
quiz.explanation: 锚; 主持人, 抛锚. The ship's captain ordered the crew to drop anchor in the bay. 船长命令船员在海湾抛锚。 | ankura->钩子（希腊），anchor->固定船只的钩=锚（cf. angle角/钓鱼，ankle踝，都与弯钩形有关） || 文化联想：中国港口里轮船停泊时抛锚最适合帮助记忆 anchor，可以说 **drop anchor — “A fishing vessel may drop anchor in a sheltered bay before the crew rests for the night.”**

quiz.question: ________ metaphor
quiz.explanation: 隐喻; 比喻, 延伸隐喻. The author used an extended metaphor throughout the novel. 作者在整部小说中使用了延伸隐喻。 | meta->跨越，phor->携带（希腊pherein），metaphor->把意义从一处携带到另一处=隐喻（cf. transfer转移，Christopher携带基督者） || 文化联想：中文常把“长城是民族的脊梁”作为隐喻式表达，最适合帮助记忆 metaphor，可以说 **an extended metaphor — “A writer may use the Great Wall as an extended metaphor for endurance, protection, and historical memory.”**

quiz.question: inferior _____
quiz.explanation: 低劣的; 次等的, 劣质商品. Consumers complained about receiving inferior goods. 消费者抱怨收到劣质商品。 | inferus->下面的（拉丁），inferior->比较级=更下面的=低劣的（cf. infernal地狱的，infra->在下面） || 文化联想：中文“劣质山寨货”最适合帮助记忆 inferior，可以说 **inferior goods — “A buyer may complain when an online seller sends inferior goods that look much worse than the advertised product.”**

quiz.question: ulterior ______
quiz.explanation: 隐秘的; 别有用心的, 隐秘动机. She suspected he had an ulterior motive for his generosity. 她怀疑他的慷慨有隐秘动机。 | ultra->超越（拉丁），ulterior->更远处的=隐藏在后面的（cf. ultimate最终的，ultra超过，exterior外部的） || 文化联想：中文“别有用心”最适合帮助记忆 ulterior，可以说 **an ulterior motive — “Someone who suddenly offers generous help only to gain a business advantage may have an ulterior motive.”**

quiz.question: anterior _______
quiz.explanation: 前面的; 先前的, 前房. The ophthalmologist examined the anterior chamber of the eye. 眼科医生检查了眼睛的前房。 | ante->前面（拉丁），anterior->比较级=更前面的（cf. antecedent前辈，antebellum战前，anterior vs posterior） || 文化联想：中国眼科检查里的“前房”最适合帮助记忆 anterior，可以说 **the anterior chamber — “An ophthalmologist may examine the anterior chamber of the eye with a slit lamp.”**

quiz.question: posterior ___________
quiz.explanation: 后面的; 后部的, 后验概率. The statistician calculated the posterior probability given new data. 统计学家根据新数据计算了后验概率。 | post->后面（拉丁），posterior->更后面的=后部的（cf. postscript附言，posterity后代，posterior vs anterior） || 文化联想：中国机器学习课堂里的贝叶斯“后验概率”最适合帮助记忆 posterior，可以说 **posterior probability — “After observing new data, a Bayesian model updates the posterior probability of a hypothesis.”**

quiz.question: _____ squalor
quiz.explanation: 肮脏; 贫困, 城市贫民窟. Many families lived in urban squalor in the neglected district. 许多家庭生活在被忽视地区的城市贫民窟中。 | squalere->肮脏（拉丁），squalor->肮脏/贫困（cf. squalid肮脏的，squall暴风=混乱，squalid conditions恶劣条件） || 文化联想：中文“脏乱差的棚户区环境”最适合帮助记忆 squalor，可以说 **urban squalor — “Neglected housing, overflowing waste, and broken sanitation can create conditions of urban squalor.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ valor
quiz.explanation: 英勇; 勇气, 英勇行为. The soldier received a medal for his act of valor. 士兵因其英勇行为获得了勋章。 | valere->强壮/有价值（拉丁），valor->力量/勇气（cf. valid有效的，value价值，valiant勇敢的） || 文化联想：岳飞等忠勇人物的文化形象最适合帮助记忆 valor，可以说 **an act of valor — “A soldier who risks his own life to rescue others under attack may be honored for an act of valor.”**

quiz.question: __________ chancellor
quiz.explanation: 大臣; 校长, 大学校长. The university chancellor welcomed new students at orientation. 大学校长在迎新会上欢迎新生。 | cancelli->格栅（拉丁，法庭格栅后的书记员），chancellor->在格栅后工作的人=大臣（cf. cancel取消=通过格栅划去） || 文化联想：chancellor 在不同国家和大学体系中的职责不同，可用中国学生学习海外大学职位来记忆，可以说 **a university chancellor — “A Chinese student reading about an overseas university may encounter the title university chancellor as a senior institutional role.”**

quiz.question: tenor _____
quiz.explanation: 男高音; 要旨, 男高音. The opera featured a famous tenor voice in the lead role. 歌剧在主角中以著名的男高音为特色。 | tenere->持续（拉丁），tenor->持续的声音/要旨（cf. tenacious坚持的，tenure任期，continue继续） || 文化联想：中国歌剧舞台上的男高音最适合帮助记忆 tenor，可以说 **a tenor voice — “A Chinese opera production may feature a powerful tenor voice in a leading male role.”**

quiz.question: ____________ boor
quiz.explanation: 粗野的人; 粗人, 令人难以忍受的粗人. The insufferable boor offended everyone at the party. 令人难以忍受的粗人冒犯了派对上的所有人。 | boer->农民（荷兰语），boor->粗鲁的乡下人=粗人（cf. Boer布尔人，neighbor邻居=附近的农民，boorish粗鲁的） || 文化联想：中文“粗野无礼的人”最适合帮助记忆 boor，可以说 **an insufferable boor — “A guest who interrupts everyone, insults the host, and ignores basic manners may be an insufferable boor.”**

quiz.question: ______ spoor
quiz.explanation: 足迹; 踪迹, 动物足迹. The hunter followed the animal spoor through the forest. 猎人沿着森林中的动物足迹追踪。 | spoor->踪迹（荷兰语/南非荷兰语），spoor->猎物留下的足迹（cf. spur马刺/激励，spoor追踪） || 文化联想：东北虎保护区里追踪动物脚印和粪迹最适合帮助记忆 spoor，可以说 **animal spoor — “Wildlife researchers may follow animal spoor such as footprints, fur, and droppings to track a tiger.”**

quiz.question: incisor _____
quiz.explanation: 门牙; 切牙, 门牙. The dentist checked each incisor tooth for cavities. 牙医检查每颗门牙是否有蛀牙。 | in->进入，cis->切，incisor->切入食物的牙=门牙（cf. incision切口，scissors剪刀，decide决定=切断犹豫） || 文化联想：中文“门牙”最适合帮助记忆 incisor，可以说 **an incisor tooth — “A dentist may repair a chipped incisor tooth at the front of a patient’s mouth.”**

quiz.question: ____ censor
quiz.explanation: 审查员; 检查, 电影审查员. The film censor removed controversial scenes from the movie. 电影审查员从电影中删除了有争议的场景。 | censor->评估者（拉丁，罗马负责道德的官员），censor->审查员（cf. census人口普查，censure谴责） || 文化联想：中文“电影审查”最适合帮助记忆 censor，可以说 **a film censor — “A film censor may review a movie according to the rules of a particular jurisdiction before public release.”**

quiz.question: ________ precursor
quiz.explanation: 先驱; 前体, 化学前体. The scientist isolated the chemical precursor to the compound. 科学家分离出该化合物的化学前体。 | pre->之前，curs->跑（拉丁currere），precursor->提前跑来的=先驱（cf. cursor光标，course路线，occur发生） || 文化联想：中国化学实验室里的反应前体最适合帮助记忆 precursor，可以说 **a chemical precursor — “A chemist may synthesize a chemical precursor that is later converted into the desired compound.”**

quiz.question: _________ predecessor
quiz.explanation: 前任; 前身, 公司前身. The new company acquired its corporate predecessor last year. 新公司去年收购了其公司前身。 | pre->之前，deces->离去（拉丁decedere），predecessor->在之前离去的人=前任（cf. decease死亡，successor继任者） || 文化联想：公司改制或并购前的“前身公司”最适合帮助记忆 predecessor，可以说 **a corporate predecessor — “A modern company may trace its roots to a smaller corporate predecessor founded decades earlier.”**

quiz.question: _______ intercessor
quiz.explanation: 调解人; 代祷者, 圣洁的代祷者. The faithful prayed to a saintly intercessor for help. 信徒向圣洁的代祷者祈祷寻求帮助。 | inter->之间，cess->走（拉丁cedere），intercessor->走入两者之间=调解者（cf. intercede调解，recess休息，concession让步） || 文化联想：intercessor 带有宗教代祷色彩，可用中国基督教语境来记忆，可以说 **a religious intercessor — “In Christian teaching, believers may describe a saint or spiritual figure as an intercessor who prays on behalf of others.”**

quiz.question: ________ aggressor
quiz.explanation: 侵略者; 挑衅者, 军事侵略者. The nation defended itself against the military aggressor. 国家抵御军事侵略者。 | ag->朝向，gress->走，aggressor->朝别人走去攻击的人=侵略者（cf. progress进步，congress会议，digress偏题） || 文化联想：中国抗战题材历史叙事里的“侵略者”最适合帮助记忆 aggressor，可以说 **a military aggressor — “A country that launches an unprovoked armed attack on another state becomes the military aggressor in the conflict.”**

quiz.question: ___ incubator
quiz.explanation: 孵化器, 孵蛋器. The farmer placed fertilized eggs in the egg incubator. 农民将受精卵放入孵蛋器中。 | in->在上，cub->躺卧，incubator->趴在上面孵化的器具=孵化器（cf. incubation孵化，succumb倒下，cubicle小隔间） || 文化联想：农村孵化小鸡使用恒温孵蛋器最适合帮助记忆 incubator，可以说 **an egg incubator — “A farmer may place fertilized eggs in an egg incubator that maintains the warmth and humidity needed for hatching.”**

quiz.question: ____ predator
quiz.explanation: 捕食者, 顶级捕食者. The lion is an apex predator in the African savanna. 狮子是非洲大草原上的顶级捕食者。 | pred->掠夺（拉丁praeda->猎物），predator->掠夺者=捕食者（cf. prey猎物，depredation掠夺，plunder劫掠） || 文化联想：东北虎在森林生态系统中的地位最适合帮助记忆 predator，可以说 **an apex predator — “The Amur tiger is an apex predator that sits near the top of its food web.”**

quiz.question: ______ defoliator
quiz.explanation: 食叶虫; 落叶剂, 森林食叶虫. The forest defoliator destroyed thousands of trees. 森林食叶虫毁坏了数千棵树。 | de->去除，foli->叶（拉丁folium），defoliator->去除树叶的东西=食叶虫/落叶剂（cf. foliage叶子，portfolio文件夹） || 文化联想：中国林业里松毛虫等食叶害虫最适合帮助记忆 defoliator，可以说 **a forest defoliator — “A severe outbreak of a leaf-eating insect can turn a forest defoliator into a major threat to tree health.”**

quiz.question: ______ generator
quiz.explanation: 发电机; 生成器, 备用发电机. The hospital relies on a backup generator during power outages. 医院在停电期间依靠备用发电机。 | gen->产生（拉丁generare），generator->产生电力的机器=发电机（cf. generate产生，generation世代，gene基因） || 文化联想：中国医院停电时启用备用发电机最适合帮助记忆 generator，可以说 **a backup generator — “A hospital may start a backup generator immediately when the main power supply fails.”**

quiz.question: ______ curator
quiz.explanation: 馆长; 策展人, 博物馆馆长. The museum curator organized a new exhibition. 博物馆馆长组织了一场新展览。 | cura->照料（拉丁curare），curator->负责照料保管的人=馆长（cf. cure治愈，curious好奇的，accurate精确的） || 文化联想：故宫博物院策划文物展览的策展人最适合帮助记忆 curator，可以说 **a museum curator — “A museum curator may select artifacts, research their history, and design the narrative of an exhibition.”**

quiz.question: ______ spectator
quiz.explanation: 观众; 旁观者, 体育观众. The sports spectator cheered loudly for his favorite team. 体育观众为他最喜欢的球队大声欢呼。 | spect->看（拉丁spectare），spectator->观看者=观众（cf. spectacular壮观的，inspect检查，expect期待） || 文化联想：中国乒乓球比赛看台上的观众最适合帮助记忆 spectator，可以说 **a sports spectator — “A sports spectator may cheer loudly during a close table-tennis final.”**

quiz.question: ____ testator
quiz.explanation: 立遗嘱人, 遗嘱立遗嘱人. The will testator must be of sound mind when signing. 遗嘱立遗嘱人在签署时必须头脑清醒。 | test->见证/遗嘱（拉丁testis->证人），testator->立下证词的人=立遗嘱人（cf. testament遗嘱，testify作证） || 文化联想：中文“立遗嘱人”最适合帮助记忆 testator，可以说 **a testator signing a will — “A testator signing a will must understand the document and meet the legal requirements of the jurisdiction.”**

quiz.question: _____ ___ equator
quiz.explanation: 赤道, 穿越赤道. The ship's crew celebrated when they would cross the equator. 当船员将要穿越赤道时,他们庆祝了一番。 | equ->相等（拉丁aequus），equator->使昼夜相等的线=赤道（cf. equal平等，equation方程，equinox春秋分） || 文化联想：中国远洋科考船穿越赤道最适合帮助记忆 equator，可以说 **cross the equator — “A Chinese research vessel sailing toward the Southern Hemisphere may cross the equator during a long ocean expedition.”**

quiz.question: _________ malefactor
quiz.explanation: 罪犯; 作恶者, 臭名昭著的罪犯. The notorious malefactor was finally captured by police. 臭名昭著的罪犯终于被警方抓获。 | male->坏，fact->做，malefactor->做坏事的人=罪犯（cf. benefactor恩人，factor因素，manufacture制造） || 文化联想：中文“作恶多端的罪犯”最适合帮助记忆 malefactor，可以说 **a notorious malefactor — “A criminal repeatedly convicted of serious fraud and violence may become known as a notorious malefactor.”**

quiz.question: _________ benefactor
quiz.explanation: 捐助者; 恩人, 匿名捐助者. An anonymous benefactor donated millions to the university. 一位匿名捐助者向大学捐赠了数百万。 | bene->好，fact->做，benefactor->做好事的人=恩人（cf. malefactor罪犯，benefit利益，beneficial有益的） || 文化联想：希望工程等公益场景里的匿名捐助者最适合帮助记忆 benefactor，可以说 **an anonymous benefactor — “An anonymous benefactor may donate money to help rural students without asking for public recognition.”**

quiz.question: hector ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 威吓; 恐吓, 恐吓员工. The manager would hector the staff unnecessarily. 经理会无端地恐吓员工。 | Hector->特洛伊战争中的英雄（后被用作欺凌者的象征），hector->欺负/恐吓（cf. lecture演讲，rector校长） || 文化联想：中文“对下属吆五喝六”最适合帮助记忆 hector，可以说 **hector the staff — “A manager who constantly shouts, threatens, and humiliates employees may hector the staff instead of leading them.”**

quiz.question: _______ projector
quiz.explanation: 投影仪, 数字投影仪. The conference room has a new digital projector. 会议室有一台新的数字投影仪。 | pro->向前，ject->投射，projector->向前投射图像的机器=投影仪（cf. project项目/投射，inject注射，eject弹出） || 文化联想：中国教室和会议室里的数字投影仪最适合帮助记忆 projector，可以说 **a digital projector — “A teacher may connect a laptop to a digital projector before showing slides to the class.”**

quiz.question: ____ proctor
quiz.explanation: 监考人, 考试监考人. The exam proctor distributed test papers to students. 考试监考人向学生分发试卷。 | proctor->procurator的缩写（代理人），proctor->监考/监督官员（cf. procure获取，proxy代理，prosecutor检察官） || 文化联想：高考考场里的监考老师最适合帮助记忆 proctor，可以说 **an exam proctor — “An exam proctor checks identification, distributes papers, and watches the room during a major test.”**

quiz.question: ______ inhibitor
quiz.explanation: 抑制剂, 酶抑制剂. The drug acts as an enzyme inhibitor in the body. 这种药物在体内充当酶抑制剂。 | in->进入，hibit->持有/阻止（拉丁habere），inhibitor->阻止进入的东西=抑制剂（cf. inhibit抑制，exhibit展示，prohibit禁止） || 文化联想：中国生物化学课堂里的酶抑制剂最适合帮助记忆 inhibitor，可以说 **an enzyme inhibitor — “A biochemistry student may study how an enzyme inhibitor reduces the activity of a specific enzyme.”**

quiz.question: ______ progenitor
quiz.explanation: 祖先; 始祖, 共同祖先. Scientists traced the species back to a common progenitor. 科学家将该物种追溯到一个共同祖先。 | pro->向前，genit->生（拉丁gignere），progenitor->最先生育的人=祖先（cf. generate产生，progeny后代，genesis起源） || 文化联想：进化论中的“共同祖先”最适合帮助记忆 progenitor，可以说 **a common progenitor — “Two related species may be traced back through evolution to a common progenitor.”**

quiz.question: _______ mentor
quiz.explanation: 导师; 顾问, 值得信赖的导师. Her trusted mentor guided her career decisions. 她值得信赖的导师指导她的职业决定。 | Mentor->荷马史诗中奥德修斯托付儿子特勒马科斯的智慧老者，mentor->导师（cf. mental精神的，comment评论） || 文化联想：“师傅领进门，修行在个人”最适合帮助记忆 mentor，可以说 **a trusted mentor — “A trusted mentor can open doors and offer guidance, while the learner still has to do the hard work—正如‘师傅领进门，修行在个人.’”**

quiz.question: ______ sculptor
quiz.explanation: 雕塑家, 大师级雕塑家. The master sculptor created lifelike marble statues. 大师级雕塑家创作了栩栩如生的大理石雕像。 | sculp->雕刻（拉丁sculpere），sculptor->雕刻者=雕塑家（cf. sculpt雕刻，sculpture雕塑） || 文化联想：龙门石窟或大型公共雕塑背后的雕塑师最适合帮助记忆 sculptor，可以说 **a master sculptor — “A master sculptor may shape stone for months before a figure’s expression and drapery finally emerge.”**

quiz.question: ______ pastor
quiz.explanation: 牧师, 教区牧师. The parish pastor delivered an inspiring sermon. 教区牧师发表了鼓舞人心的布道。 | pastor->牧羊人（拉丁），pastor->牧养羊群/引导信众的人=牧师（cf. pasture牧场，pastoral田园的，pasteurize巴氏杀菌） || 文化联想：pastor 是基督教牧师，可用中国教堂的教区牧师来记忆，可以说 **a parish pastor — “A parish pastor in a church community may lead worship, counsel families, and organize charitable work.”**

quiz.question: ______ impostor
quiz.explanation: 冒名顶替者; 骗子, 狡猾的冒名顶替者. The clever impostor fooled everyone for months. 狡猾的冒名顶替者欺骗了所有人好几个月。 | im->进入，pos->放置，impostor->把自己放入别人位置的人=冒名顶替者（cf. impose强加，impost税，imposter美式拼写） || 文化联想：中文“冒名顶替的骗子”最适合帮助记忆 impostor，可以说 **a clever impostor — “A clever impostor may use forged documents and a convincing story to pretend to be someone else.”**

quiz.question: _____-______ interlocutor
quiz.explanation: 对话者; 谈话者, 机智的对话者. The quick-witted interlocutor kept the discussion lively. 机智的对话者使讨论保持活跃。 | inter->之间，locut->说话，interlocutor->在两者之间说话的人=对话者（cf. circumlocution迂回说法，elocution演讲术） || 文化联想：学术访谈里机智、善于回应的对话者最适合帮助记忆 interlocutor，可以说 **a quick-witted interlocutor — “A quick-witted interlocutor can keep an academic discussion lively by asking sharp questions and responding thoughtfully.”**

quiz.question: _______ tutor
quiz.explanation: 家庭教师; 导师, 私人家庭教师. They hired a private tutor to help with mathematics. 他们聘请了一位私人家庭教师来辅导数学。 | tutor->守护者（拉丁tutus->保护），tutor->保护/指导学生的人=导师（cf. intuition直觉=向内守护，tutelage监护） || 文化联想：中国家庭请数学家教最适合帮助记忆 tutor，可以说 **a private tutor — “Parents may hire a private tutor to help a student strengthen mathematics before an important exam.”**

quiz.question: ______ languor
quiz.explanation: 倦怠; 慵懒, 夏日慵懒. A feeling of summer languor settled over the town. 夏日慵懒的感觉笼罩着小镇。 | languere->虚弱（拉丁），languor->虚弱慵懒的状态（cf. languid无精打采的，language语言=无力说话？） || 文化联想：南方炎热午后让人昏昏欲睡的感觉最适合帮助记忆 languor，可以说 **summer languor — “On a humid afternoon when even the cicadas seem slow, a sense of summer languor may settle over the neighborhood.”**

quiz.question: _________ fervor
quiz.explanation: 热情; 热诚, 宗教热情. The congregation sang with religious fervor. 会众以宗教热情歌唱。 | fervere->沸腾（拉丁），fervor->沸腾般的热情（cf. fervent热情的，fermentation发酵，fever发烧） || 文化联想：fervor 在这里是宗教热情，可用中国教堂礼拜场景来记忆，可以说 **religious fervor — “During a major church celebration, a congregation may sing and pray with intense religious fervor.”**

quiz.question: ____ surveyor
quiz.explanation: 测量员, 土地测量员. The land surveyor marked the property boundaries. 土地测量员标记了财产边界。 | sur->在上，vey->看（法语voir），surveyor->从上面看/测量的人=测量员（cf. survey调查，surveillance监视，vision视野） || 文化联想：中国买房或工程项目测量地界最适合帮助记忆 surveyor，可以说 **a land surveyor — “A land surveyor may mark the exact boundary of a property before construction begins.”**

quiz.question: ______ centaur
quiz.explanation: 半人马, 神话中的半人马. Ancient Greeks told stories about the mythic centaur. 古希腊人讲述关于神话中的半人马的故事。 | kentauros->半人马（希腊神话），centaur->上半人下半马的神话生物（cf. Sagittarius射手座也是半人马形象） || 文化联想：centaur 是古希腊半人马，可用中国学生读西方神话的场景来记忆，可以说 **a mythical centaur — “A Chinese student reading Greek mythology may picture a mythical centaur as a creature with a human upper body and a horse’s body below.”**

quiz.question: incur _____
quiz.explanation: 招致; 遭受, 招致成本. The company will incur costs from the expansion project. 公司将因扩张项目招致成本。 | in->进入，cur->跑（拉丁currere），incur->跑进去遭遇=招致（cf. occur发生，recur复发，excursion远足） || 文化联想：买房装修或公司扩张都会“产生额外成本”，最适合帮助记忆 incur，可以说 **incur costs — “A renovation project may incur costs beyond the original budget when hidden structural problems are discovered.”**

quiz.question: concur ____
quiz.explanation: 同意; 一致, 同意. The committee members concur with the proposed changes. 委员会成员同意提议的变更。 | con->共同，cur->跑，concur->共同跑到同一结论=同意（cf. occur发生，concurrent同时发生的，currency流通货币） || 文化联想：中文“意见一致”最适合帮助记忆 concur，可以说 **concur with a proposal — “After reviewing the evidence, several committee members may concur with the proposed solution.”**

quiz.question: ________ grandeur
quiz.explanation: 壮丽; 宏伟, 帝国的壮丽. The palace displayed imperial grandeur and opulence. 宫殿展现了帝国的壮丽和华丽。 | grand->伟大（法语，拉丁grandis），grandeur->伟大壮丽（cf. grand大的，grandiose宏大的，grandmother祖母） || 文化联想：故宫宏大的宫殿格局最适合帮助记忆 grandeur，可以说 **imperial grandeur — “The scale of the Forbidden City, from its gates to its ceremonial halls, conveys imperial grandeur.”**

quiz.question: ____ entrepreneur
quiz.explanation: 企业家, 科技企业家. The young tech entrepreneur launched a successful startup. 年轻的科技企业家创办了一家成功的初创公司。 | entre->在...之间，prendre->拿取（法语），entrepreneur->在不同人之间承揽事业的人=企业家（cf. enterprise企业） || 文化联想：深圳科技创业者最适合帮助记忆 entrepreneur，可以说 **a tech entrepreneur — “A young tech entrepreneur in Shenzhen may build a startup around hardware, software, or artificial intelligence.”**

quiz.question: _______ poseur
quiz.explanation: 装腔作势者, 时尚装腔作势者. The fashion poseur wore designer labels to impress others. 时尚装腔作势者穿名牌服装以打动他人。 | poser->摆姿势者（法语），poseur->故意摆出虚伪姿态的人=装腔作势者（cf. pose摆姿势，impostor冒名顶替者） || 文化联想：中文“穿名牌摆姿势、装腔作势的人”最适合帮助记忆 poseur，可以说 **a fashion poseur — “Someone who wears designer labels only to impress strangers may come across as a fashion poseur.”**

quiz.question: ____ connoisseur
quiz.explanation: 鉴赏家, 葡萄酒鉴赏家. The wine connoisseur could identify vintages by taste. 葡萄酒鉴赏家可以通过品尝识别年份。 | connaître->认识（法语，拉丁cognoscere），connoisseur->深入认识的人=鉴赏家（cf. cognition认知，recognize认识，reconnoiter侦察） || 文化联想：中国茶文化里的资深品茶人最适合帮助记忆 connoisseur，可以说 **a tea connoisseur — “A tea connoisseur may identify differences among Longjing teas by aroma, leaf shape, mouthfeel, and aftertaste.”**

quiz.question: _____ raconteur
quiz.explanation: 善于讲故事的人, 机智的故事讲述者. The witty raconteur entertained guests with amusing tales. 机智的故事讲述者用有趣的故事娱乐客人。 | raconter->讲述（法语，re+compter->重新计数/讲述），raconteur->善于讲故事的人（cf. recount重述，account叙述） || 文化联想：中国茶馆里善讲掌故、把一桌人逗乐的说书人最适合帮助记忆 raconteur，可以说 **a witty raconteur — “A witty raconteur in a teahouse may entertain guests with colorful stories about old Beijing or Shanghai.”**

quiz.question: _____ saboteur
quiz.explanation: 破坏者, 敌方破坏者. Security forces captured an enemy saboteur near the facility. 安全部队在设施附近抓获了一名敌方破坏者。 | sabot->木鞋（法语），saboteur->工人用木鞋踩坏机器以抗议=破坏者（cf. sabotage蓄意破坏） || 文化联想：抗战题材影视中潜入破坏设施的敌方人员最适合帮助记忆 saboteur，可以说 **an enemy saboteur — “In a wartime drama, security guards may discover an enemy saboteur trying to damage a bridge or communications line.”**

quiz.question: ____ hauteur
quiz.explanation: 傲慢; 高傲, 冷酷的傲慢. She treated everyone with cold hauteur and disdain. 她以冷酷的傲慢和轻蔑对待每个人。 | haut->高（法语，拉丁altus），hauteur->居高临下的态度=傲慢（cf. haughty傲慢的，haute cuisine高级料理） || 文化联想：中文“居高临下、冷冰冰的傲慢”最适合帮助记忆 hauteur，可以说 **cold hauteur — “Someone who barely acknowledges ordinary people and speaks as if everyone else were beneath them may display cold hauteur.”**

quiz.question: augur ____
quiz.explanation: 预示; 占卜, 预示良好. The early results augur well for the company's future. 早期结果为公司的未来预示良好。 | augur->罗马占卜官（观察鸟的飞行预测吉凶），augur->预示（cf. inaugural就职的=用占卜开始，August八月=奥古斯都大帝月） || 文化联想：中文“开门红是个好兆头”最适合帮助记忆 augur，可以说 **augur well — “A strong first month of sales may augur well for the rest of the year—像中文所说的‘开门红.’”**

quiz.question: dour __________
quiz.explanation: 严厉的; 阴郁的, 阴郁的表情. His dour expression revealed his disapproval. 他阴郁的表情显露出他的不满。 | durus->坚硬/严酷（拉丁），dour->严酷阴沉的（cf. durable耐久的，endure忍耐，duration持续时间） || 文化联想：中文“板着一张脸、阴沉严肃”最适合帮助记忆 dour，可以说 **a dour expression — “A strict teacher entering the room with a dour expression may quiet the class immediately.”**

quiz.question: _____ downpour
quiz.explanation: 倾盆大雨, 大暴雨. A heavy downpour forced everyone indoors. 大暴雨迫使所有人待在室内。 | down->向下，pour->倾泻，downpour->向下倾泻的雨=倾盆大雨（cf. pour倾倒，outpour涌出，downfall下落/衰败） || 文化联想：南方夏季突然一场“倾盆大雨”最适合帮助记忆 downpour，可以说 **a heavy downpour — “A heavy downpour during the summer monsoon can flood streets within minutes.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ detour
quiz.explanation: 绕道; 迂回, 绕道. We had to take a detour because of road construction. 我们不得不绕道,因为道路施工。 | de->离开，tour->转/旅行（法语），detour->转离原路=绕道（cf. tour旅游，contour轮廓） || 文化联想：中国城市修路时司机常被迫绕行，最适合帮助记忆 detour，可以说 **take a detour — “When a road is closed for construction, a driver may have to take a detour through nearby streets.”**

quiz.question: devour _ ____
quiz.explanation: 吞食; 狼吞虎咽, 一口气读完一本书. She would devour a book in a single sitting. 她会一口气读完一本书。 | de->彻底，vour->吞食（拉丁vorare），devour->彻底吞噬（cf. voracious贪吃的，carnivore肉食动物） || 文化联想：中文“废寝忘食地一口气读完”最适合帮助记忆 devour，可以说 **devour a book — “A reader fascinated by a wuxia novel may devour a book in one sitting and forget the time completely.”**

quiz.question: spur ______
quiz.explanation: 马刺; 刺激, 刺激增长. Tax incentives can spur growth in the economy. 税收优惠可以刺激经济增长。 | spur->马刺（古英语spura），spur->像马刺一样刺激=激励（cf. spurn用脚踢开，on the spur of the moment一时冲动） || 文化联想：中文“政策刺激经济增长”最适合帮助记忆 spur，可以说 **spur growth — “Investment in transport and technology can spur growth by improving productivity and creating new demand.”**

quiz.question: ______ zephyr
quiz.explanation: 和风; 微风, 春天的微风. A gentle spring zephyr rustled the leaves. 轻柔的春天微风吹动树叶。 | Zephyros->西风之神（希腊神话），zephyr->轻柔的西风/微风 || 文化联想：江南春天柳枝轻摆的和风最适合帮助记忆 zephyr，可以说 **a spring zephyr — “A gentle spring zephyr may ripple the surface of West Lake and stir the willow branches.”**

quiz.question: _________ martyr
quiz.explanation: 殉道者; 烈士, 基督教殉道者. The Christian martyr died for his faith. 基督教殉道者为信仰而死。 | martyr->见证者（希腊martys->证人），martyr->用生命见证信仰的人=殉道者 || 文化联想：martyr 在这里是基督教“殉道者”，可用中国学生学习宗教史时来记忆，可以说 **a Christian martyr — “In a history-of-religion class, students may learn about a Christian martyr who died rather than renounce the faith.”**

quiz.question: ______ fracas
quiz.explanation: 喧闹; 吵闹, 街头喧闹. A street fracas broke out between rival groups. 对立团体之间爆发了街头喧闹。 | fracasser->打碎（法语），fracas->打碎东西的喧闹=吵闹冲突（cf. fracture骨折，fragile易碎的） || 文化联想：中文“街头发生一场吵闹冲突”最适合帮助记忆 fracas，可以说 **a street fracas — “A minor argument outside a restaurant can turn into a street fracas if several people begin shouting and pushing.”**

quiz.question: pancreas ________
quiz.explanation: 胰腺, 胰腺功能. Diabetes affects pancreas function significantly. 糖尿病严重影响胰腺功能。 | pan->全部，kreas->肉（希腊），pancreas->全是肉的=胰腺（cf. pandemic全球性的） || 文化联想：中国医院内分泌科检查胰腺功能最适合帮助记忆 pancreas，可以说 **pancreas function — “Doctors may evaluate pancreas function when a patient has problems with blood sugar or digestion.”**

quiz.question: ___ specifics
quiz.explanation: 具体细节, 具体细节. Let us discuss the specifics of the proposal. 让我们讨论提案的具体细节。 | spec->看/具体（拉丁species->种类），specifics->具体细节（cf. species物种，specimen样本） || 文化联想：中文“别泛泛而谈，讲具体细节”最适合帮助记忆 specifics，可以说 **the specifics — “Before signing a contract, a buyer should ask about the specifics of price, deadlines, and responsibilities.”**

quiz.question: ____________ ethics
quiz.explanation: 伦理学; 道德规范, 职业道德. Doctors must adhere to professional ethics standards. 医生必须遵守职业道德标准。 | ethos->品格/气质（希腊），ethics->关于品格的学问=伦理学（cf. ethnic民族的） || 文化联想：中文“职业道德”最适合帮助记忆 ethics，可以说 **professional ethics — “Doctors, lawyers, and engineers are expected to follow professional ethics even when doing so is inconvenient.”**

quiz.question: ____ ceramics
